hf.title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
hf.abstract: The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics. Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks. Instead of training a dedicated policy for each family of tasks, an agentic robotic system applies a foundation model to open-world embodied tasks. It operates in a closed loop: observing the environment, interpreting user intent, reasoning about the task, invoking skills and tools, verifying outcomes, and adapting its strategy. Despite these advances, the community has yet to converge on a shared definition, a reliable evaluation framework, or a research roadmap. We argue that Embodied System 2, realized by a foundation model together with an embodied harness, forms the decision-making core of agentic robotics. Its central challenge is to translate general-purpose reasoning into effective and verifiable actions under physical constraints such as limited reaction time, mechanical limits, unpredictable environment changes, and irreversible consequences. Motivated by this perspective, we propose an evaluation framework that measures both model capabilities and closed-loop system performance. Furthermore, we identify the principles that carry over from digital to physical agents and the challenges that must be addressed to achieve reliable physical autonomy. On top of the Embodied System 2 and the evaluation framework, we envision a research roadmap toward sustained autonomy: the ability to perform work safely and reliably with progressively broader responsibility, from executing individual primitives to fulfilling standing roles.
hf.titleZh: 展望智能体式机器人:机器人系统的新纪元
hf.summaryZh: 针对为每类任务单独训练专用策略的低效，提出由基础模型与具身harness共同构成的Embodied System 2作为智能体式机器人的决策核心，在观察环境、理解意图、任务推理、调用技能与工具、验证结果、调整策略的闭环中完成开放世界具身任务。核心难点在于把通用推理转译为物理约束(有限反应时间、机械极限、环境突变、不可逆后果)下有效且可验证的动作，并给出同时衡量模型能力与闭环系统性能的评估框架。进一步辨析哪些原则可从数字智能体迁移到物理智能体，并规划从执行单一原语到承担长期职责的持续自主路线图。
hf.reason: 智能体式机器人范式定义与评估路线图，直接命中高分方向

hf.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
hf.abstract: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.
hf.titleZh: Gamer：面向长程实时游戏智能体的通用视觉-语言-动作基础模型
hf.summaryZh: 面向复杂交互环境中的长程任务构建端到端通用智能体，把感知、记忆管理与多步推理解在共享的训练—部署管线中，同时支持 2D 图形界面与 3D 仿真世界。先在数万小时设备级键鼠交互轨迹（覆盖模拟游戏与具身环境）上继续预训练，再用稀疏思考指令微调压缩冗余计算，并以稳定的多轮强化学习方法应对有限上下文、rollout 误差累积与稀疏奖励。推理侧用云边协同引擎并发服务大量仿真环境，支持无界上下文执行并保持低在线延迟。在多个 3D 开放世界游戏中泛化性与效率接近熟练玩家，在 2D 游戏基准上同样有竞争力。
hf.reason: 通用智能体基础模型，多轮 RL 与长程推理方法扎实，直击 Agent 方向

hf.title: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
hf.abstract: Controllable real-world video generation models can condition on a rendered graybox proxy video, which fixes layout, motion and camera. Coding agents can build such videos by reconstructing a 4D scene in Blender, yet no benchmark checks both these videos and the long, multi-shot scenes behind them. We introduce VibePrevisBench, a benchmark for 4D scene reconstruction: an agent turns a brief into an executable 4D scene and renders its proxy video. Its 242 tasks span four input kinds, including scripts, photos, continuations, and reference videos. Each delivery is scored along two evaluation dimensions. Rule-based Scene Check re-runs the code and compares the exported 4D scene with hidden ground truth facts in nine dimensions. VLM-based Screen Check asks a VLM judge whether the facts that pass can be recognized in the proxy video. We analyze the evaluation results and trajectories of 11 frontier coding agents and identify three key observations. First, multimodal understanding separates the agents, especially in understanding space and camera motion. Second, all agents seem to already master basic camera work and staging, and fail at challenging requests. Third, agents inspect their own renders but fail to correct their errors. Agents thus need better visual understanding of space and camera, explicit checks for challenging requests, and item-by-item verification of renders against the brief.
hf.titleZh: VibePrevisBench:评估 Blender 中 4D 场景生成的智能体编程能力
hf.summaryZh: 为可控真实视频生成提供 graybox 代理视频，需要先在 Blender 中重建 4D 场景;现有 benchmark 既不检验渲染出的代理视频，也不检验其背后长时多镜头场景。为此构建 VibePrevisBench，含 242 个任务，输入覆盖脚本、照片、续写和参考视频四类，要求 coding agent 从简短需求生成可执行的 4D 场景并渲染代理视频;评分分两路:规则式 Scene Check 重跑代码并将导出的 4D 场景与隐藏真值事实在九个维度上比对，VLM 式 Screen Check 由 VLM 裁判判断通过的事实能否在代理视频中被识别。对 11 个前沿 coding agent 的评测显示，多模态理解(尤其空间与相机运动)是主要区分因素，各 agent 已掌握基础运镜与场面调度但在高难请求上失败，且会检查自身渲染结果却无法据此纠错。
hf.reason: LLM 智能体编程与多模态评测交叉，偏 4D 场景生成，擦边但有参考价值

hf.title: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System
hf.abstract: Long-term memory lets LLM agents personalize, stay consistent, and reuse what worked before. Parametric memories need training, consolidation can lose details for good, and keeping every record leaves a growing store to search. We present MIRIX-2.0, a multi-agent memory system designed to be practical, accurate, and efficient at once. It is the most accurate of the compared systems on four of five QA benchmarks. It reaches 91.4% on LoCoMo and 72.6% on LongMemEval-S, where it leads the strongest baseline by 14.3 points, and with AutoDream disabled it gains 31.0 and 22.0 points over HyperMem on single-hop and multi-hop document QA. As procedural memory, it yields the highest mean success among the compared memory methods on ALFWorld and WebShop and reaches 49.2% on MetaClaw-Bench, against 44.0% for MetaClaw's skill library. Six typed memory agents keep complete records as the system of record, and a provenance hypergraph indexes episodic and semantic records with n-ary frames that cite their rows. Retrieval runs under explicit budgets, so the evidence a question inspects does not grow with the history. AutoDream merges duplicate anchors outside the write path without rewriting any record, and it distills task sessions into skills. With AutoDream disabled, MIRIX-2.0 answers faster than HyperMem on all five timed benchmarks. It needs no fine-tuning, runs with closed and open models, and its code is public.
hf.titleZh: MIRIX-2.0:多智能体记忆系统
hf.summaryZh: 参数化记忆需训练、逐次整合时易永久丢失细节、全量留存又让检索库无限膨胀，为此构建多智能体长期记忆系统:六类记忆智能体保存完整记录作为系统的权威数据源，溯源超图用 n 元框架索引情景与语义记录，并引用这些记录对应的原始行，检索在显式预算下进行，使单次问答检视的证据量不随历史增长;AutoDream 在写入路径之外合并重复锚点，并且不重写任何记录，同时把任务会话蒸馏为技能。五个 QA 基准中有四个准确率最高(LoCoMo 91.4%、LongMemEval-S 72.6%，比最强基线高 14.3 分)，在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上平均成功率最高，MetaClaw-Bench 达 49.2%。系统无需微调、兼容闭源与开源模型，适用于需长期一致性与技能复用的 Agent。
hf.reason: Agent 长期记忆系统，多个基准表现领先且机制完整

hf.title: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
hf.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose tokens for parallel verification by a target model. Diffusion drafters such as DFlash propose an entire token block in a single forward pass, but mainly focus on text-only tasks, leaving multimodal drafting underexplored. To study this setting, we first introduce a metric of token-level visual dependence based on the KL divergence between next-token distributions with and without visual input. We find that acceptance rates decrease from 46% in the lowest visual-dependence quartile to 22% in the highest, with this disparity persisting after multimodal training. Motivated by this observation, we propose MMFlash, a simple and effective framework that adaptively upweights visually dependent tokens that the drafter predicts poorly. For long video inputs, MMFlash further employs sparse attention to reduce redundant attention computation and improve drafting quality. Across various multimodal benchmarks, MMFlash achieves lossless decoding speedups of up to 3.58times, outperforming EAGLE-3 and DFlash by up to 195.4% and 17.1%, respectively.
hf.titleZh: MMFlash:面向视觉语言模型的更快的投机解码
hf.summaryZh: 扩散式 drafters 能在单次前向中提出整块 token，但此前主要面向纯文本任务，多模态投机解码的接受率问题未被充分研究。作者提出基于有无视觉输入时下一 token 分布 KL 散度的 token 级视觉依赖度量，发现接受率从最低依赖四分位的 46% 降至最高依赖四分位的 22%，且多模态训练后差距依然存在。MMFlash 据此对 drafter 预测较差的视觉依赖 token 自适应加权，并对长视频输入采用稀疏注意力减少冗余计算。在多模态 benchmark 上实现最高 3.58 倍无损加速，分别超过 EAGLE-3 与 DFlash 达 195.4% 与 17.1%。
hf.reason: 多模态 VLM 投机解码，效率与架构方向扎实，数据充分

hf.title: Rethinking in Spikes: Mitigating Hallucinations in MDLMs with Step-Aware Decoding
hf.abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal diffusion language models (MDLMs) have exhibited strong global modeling capabilities through iterative refinement. We observe that mask uncertainty follows an overall downward trend during iterative denoising, while a few denoising steps exhibit localized entropy spikes closely associated with hallucinations. We argue that anomalous steps can be identified by measuring the entropy deviation of each denoising step from its neighboring temporal window. We hypothesize that discrete token commitment discards the distributional information at masked positions, limiting the continued interaction between candidate semantics and the context during entropy spikes. With this goal, we present StepRefine, a plug-and-play decoding strategy that leverages semantic context to achieve reliable denoising. The core of our method lies in a step-aware switch between discrete denoising and latent refinement. The model employs probability-weighted embeddings at entropy spike steps to preserve diverse reasoning hypotheses and performs multiple rounds of continuous refinement. Meanwhile, a refinement controller monitors distributional stability to reduce unnecessary loops and switch the model back to standard discrete denoising. Through extensive experiments, StepRefine demonstrates significant hallucination mitigation across different MDLMs on multimodal benchmarks.
hf.titleZh: 尖峰中的再思考:用步骤感知解码缓解MDLM幻觉
hf.summaryZh: 观察到多模态扩散语言模型迭代去噪时掩码不确定性整体下降，但少数去噪步出现局部熵尖峰，且与幻觉高度相关;用每步熵相对邻近时间窗的偏差即可定位这些异常步。据此提出即插即用解码策略StepRefine:在熵尖峰步以概率加权嵌入保留多样推理假设并做多轮连续精炼，同时由精炼控制器监控分布稳定性，及时切回标准离散去噪。在多个MDLM与多模态基准上显著缓解幻觉。
hf.reason: 扩散语言模型按画像一刀切归低分，仅解码与幻觉缓解略沾边

hf.title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
hf.abstract: World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs. But each caption or question names only a few attributes of a clip, so the model learns to retrieve those attributes rather than to read the clip, and the dynamics the encoder carries go unused: on the same items, a linear probe reads speed from frozen V-JEPA features at 87% while the VLM answers at chance. We show where dynamics lives in a frozen encoder: in a subspace shared across videos for predictive encoders such as V-JEPA, but not as a shared component of frame-wise, text-aligned encoders such as SigLIP. We then build counterfactual supervision that makes the language model read it: pixel transformations turn public videos into answer-balanced variants whose answers are set by the transformation and differ only in the change. Trained in a single stage on 4.53M public samples with 32 visual tokens per frame, where open video LLMs use several stages, 9M to 172M samples and 64 to 256 tokens per frame on average, the resulting V-JEPA-LM models (1B to 8B, Qwen3 and Llama) lead every size class in average score across eleven video benchmarks; our 4B model scores 72.1, against 61.1 for the best open 4B and 64.8 for the best open 8B model. A controlled encoder x supervision study shows that the encoder decides what can be read and the supervision what is read: at a matched budget, counterfactual supervision adds 4.5 points on average and 38 on the speed questions of natural benchmarks. Code and models: https://github.com/kkt94/Llama-V-JEPA-LM.
hf.titleZh: V-JEPA-LM：读取动态、超越静态文本对齐表征的视频语言模型
hf.summaryZh: 视频语言模型通常把 V-JEPA 等世界模型编码器与语言模型拼接，但字幕与问答只标注少量属性，模型倾向检索属性而非读取视频动态：冻结特征上线性探针读速度可达 87%，VLM 却只有随机水平。作者定位动态信息位于预测式编码器的跨视频共享子空间（SigLIP 等逐帧文本对齐编码器没有），并用像素变换构造答案由变换决定、仅在变化维度上不同的反事实监督样本，迫使语言模型读取动态。单阶段在 4.53M 公开样本、每帧 32 个视觉 token 上训练 1B–8B 的 V-JEPA-LM（Qwen3/Llama），在 11 个视频基准上各尺寸领先，4B 平均 72.1，高于最佳开源 4B 的 61.1 与 8B 的 64.8；匹配预算下反事实监督平均提升 4.5 分，速度题提升 38 分。
hf.reason: 视觉编码器与 LLM 结合的视频理解架构及监督设计，命中多模态理解方向

hf.title: Loopback Transformer: Towards a Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers
hf.abstract: Looped Transformers reduce parameter count by repeatedly applying shared blocks, but parameter sharing alone does not determine how the results of repeated computation are reused. We take the depth-memory view of residual connections and analyze which representation is stored after each block application and how later reads weight it. A full block output contains both its input and its new update, so weighting that output also reweights the history already carried by the input. Reading individual updates instead, with the shared stack's input kept on a separate path, gives separate controls over input strength, total update weight, and allocation across updates. The Loopback Transformer implements these controls: geometric decay sets the total update weight and supplies a recency prior, and attention learns how to allocate that weight. On ClimbMix, Loopback reaches lower validation loss than standard Transformer baselines with 40-75% of their Transformer parameters (excluding token embeddings and the output head) at reference scales from 191M to 3B, with training tokens and executed depth matched. It also has higher mean accuracy over thirteen downstream tasks at 1.4B and 3B. At 191M, 374M, and 778M, it has the lowest validation loss and the highest thirteen-task mean among the standard Transformer and seven looped residual designs.
hf.titleZh: 回环 Transformer：迈向残差循环 Transformer 的统一视角
hf.summaryZh: 残差循环 Transformer 的参数共享并不决定重复计算结果如何被复用。该工作从深度-记忆视角拆解残差连接，指出整块输出同时含输入与新增更新，加权输出会连带重加权历史；改为读取单个更新、把共享栈输入放在独立通路，可分别控制输入强度、更新总权重与更新间分配。Loopback Transformer 用几何衰减设定更新总权重并提供近因先验，由注意力学习分配，在 ClimbMix 上以标准 Transformer 40–75% 的参数（191M–3B）取得更低验证损失，1.4B 与 3B 上十三项下游任务平均准确率更高。
hf.reason: 循环 Transformer 架构新视角，直接命中架构与预训练方向

hf.title: DySENSE: Dynamic Spatiotemporal ENergy Synthesis and Emulation with Satellite Imagery
hf.abstract: Cities account for over two-thirds of the world's energy and more than 70% of global carbon dioxide emissions. City energy is essential for achieving the 2050 net-zero target and the UN's Sustainable Development Goals 7 and 11. Although existing studies have made progress, they are limited by data and methodological gaps. Existing studies are largely predictive for existing cities rather than generative for future cities; fine-grained, aligned monthly dynamic energy data are scarce; and existing GenAI models struggle to generate dynamic urban functional monthly energy. We present DySENSE, a joint multimodal GenAI framework that synthesizes static urban satellite imagery together with spatially aligned, dynamic monthly building energy consumption maps. We decouple long-term static urban morphology from short-term dynamic energy consumption. By conditioning on static urban land use, DySENSE can generate realistic, diverse and new static urban imagery with aligned energy maps. By conditioning on dynamic monthly and climate prompts, DySENSE can jointly generate dynamic, monthly energy consumption maps while keeping the urban morphology static. Experiments across four cities (New York, Washington, Norfolk, Busan) demonstrated that DySENSE can generate annotated high-fidelity synthetic energy data using less than 25% labelled data, boosting downstream prediction performance by 8% mIoU, and achieving strong energy dynamic consistency. Compared to existing methods, DySENSE significantly improved prediction performance (8.7% accuracy) and reduced prediction error (9%-18% CVRMSE, ASHRAE). DySENSE offers an effective foundation for energy-efficient cities, peak-load analysis, building performance simulation and dynamic demand response for city, energy, and building science. The data and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/skl24/MUSE2 and https://github.com/kailaisun/DySENSE
hf.titleZh: DySENSE:基于卫星影像的动态时空能源合成与仿真
hf.summaryZh: 城市能源研究缺少细粒度、时空对齐的月度动态能耗数据，现有生成式模型难以生成动态的城市功能月度能耗。DySENSE 是一个联合多模态生成框架，将长期静态城市形态与短期动态能耗解耦:以静态土地利用为条件生成城市卫星影像及空间对齐的能耗图，以月度与气候提示为条件在保持城市形态不变的前提下生成动态月度能耗图。在纽约、华盛顿、诺福克、釜山四个城市上，用不到 25% 的标注数据生成高保真合成能耗数据，使下游预测 mIoU 提升 8%，相比现有方法预测准确率提升 8.7%,CVRMSE 降低 9%–18%(ASHRAE)。该工作可服务于节能城市、峰值负荷分析、建筑性能仿真与动态需求响应。
hf.reason: 城市能源与卫星影像生成，属图像生成及垂直行业应用，偏离关注方向

hf.title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
hf.abstract: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), an increasing number of users are turning to LLM-powered agents for conversational shopping in e-commerce. However, the user needs continue to change as new product categories, procurement scenarios, and feature requests emerge. At the same time, the product's execution harness-including its tools, skills, and operating procedures-continues to evolve to support increasingly sophisticated interactions. These changes create two practical challenges: 1) Demand drift alters the distribution, intent, and complexity of user requests, causing a model trained once to fall behind; 2) Harness evolution requires the model to use newly introduced capabilities correctly without losing behavior that users already rely on. Periodic manual retraining is too delayed and labor-intensive for this setting. To address these challenges, we present G-CAST, a governed continual self-training system that converts daily production evidence under evolving demand and capability contracts into reward-routed, entropy-prioritized training data and governed reward evolution. Governed checkpoint transition under cumulative evaluation controls each model update, enabling the agent to learn newly introduced behaviors without sacrificing previously accepted capabilities. Experiments on a real production e-commerce agent show that G-CAST achieves stronger adaptation to newly introduced demand while better preserving previously accepted behavior compared with a strong autonomous post-training baseline. Ablations further show that both reward-routed, entropy-prioritized data orchestration and governed reward evolution are important to these gains. G-CAST is now deployed in Yuancai(http://cai.1688.com/), a B2B procurement agent on Alibaba's 1688 platform.
hf.titleZh: G-CAST：面向演化需求的电商Agent受治理持续自训练
hf.summaryZh: 电商购物Agent面临需求漂移与执行harness（工具、技能、操作规程）持续演进两大挑战，一次性训练会迅速落后，而周期性人工重训又太慢、成本太高。G-CAST将每日生产证据在需求契约与能力契约下转化为按奖励路由、按熵排序的训练数据，并引入受治理的奖励演化；每次模型更新都经由累积评估下的受治理checkpoint切换把关。在真实生产电商Agent上，G-CAST对新引入需求的适应更强，同时更好地保留既有已验收行为，消融显示数据编排与奖励演化两项机制均不可或缺；系统已部署于阿里巴巴1688平台的B2B采购Agent元采。
hf.reason: Agent持续自训练+奖励演化，有生产部署与消融，命中Agent与后训练方向

hf.title: Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device
hf.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) running on mobile devices can keep user data private and work without connectivity. But they perform well only when fine-tuned for the target task and sized for the target device, a process that today requires repeated expert tuning. We present {\it Mobile AI Factory}, an agentic system that builds a fine-tuned, quantized SLM for a given task and phone. Given a task specification and a target phone, an orchestrator LLM chooses whether to tune hyperparameters, mine real data, or generate synthetic examples, while fixed rules roll back changes that hurt accuracy. The factory searches from small to large models across base models and quantizations, adapts its accuracy goal as it searches, and uses real measurements of the target phone across inference engines and backends. We evaluate Mobile AI Factory on ten tasks and four Android phones. On an unseen testset, its on-device models outperform two five-shot frontier models on five tasks, by up to 0.34, and match them on three more. Its search comes within 0.03 of exhaustively training all 27 model variants on an entity extraction task, while using 19times less GPU time. Phone measurements also matter: the best configuration changes across phones. Without phone measurements, Claude Opus 5.5, given the full hardware and model specifications, misses the app's requirements in 25\% of easy and moderate cases and in 60\% of hard ones. Code is available at: https://github.com/evanly-gh/SLM_Factory.
hf.titleZh: Mobile AI Factory：为你的移动设备构建专用语言模型
hf.summaryZh: 目标是让端侧小模型在特定任务与机型上真正可用：搭建 agentic 系统 Mobile AI Factory，由编排 LLM 在调超参、挖掘真实数据、合成样本之间做决策，并用固定规则回滚会损害精度的改动；同时按基座模型与量化方案由小到大搜索，以目标手机在多种推理引擎与后端上的实测结果约束配置。在 10 个任务、4 台 Android 手机上，端侧模型在 5 个任务上超过两个 five-shot 前沿模型（最高 0.34），另 3 个持平；实体抽取任务上接近穷举 27 个变体（差 0.03 以内），GPU 时间少 19 倍。缺少真机测量时，即便给全硬件规格，Claude Opus 5.5 仍在 25% 的简单／中等案例与 60% 的困难案例上不满足应用要求。
hf.reason: Agent 驱动的端侧小模型自动调优与量化部署，系统性强

hf.title: MEM-SQL: Memory-Empowered Text-to-SQL
hf.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language questions into SQL queries over increasingly complex databases. However, widely used benchmarks evaluate questions independently, overlooking settings where earlier queries over the same database can supply joins or calculations for a new question. We introduce HARE (History-AwaRe Text-to-SQL BEnchmark) to measure the accuracy and cost of adapting historical SQL. HARE comprises 1,600 requests derived from a fixed pool of 823 verified queries across four datasets. Annotations record which components each request preserves and which edits it requires, distinguishing whole-query adaptation from partial reuse. Our method, MEM-SQL (Memory-EMpowered Text-to-SQL), stores whole-query templates, reusable SQL blocks, and mappings from domain concepts to schema elements. MEM-SQL uses a layer only if every requirement assigned to it has a match above that layer's threshold. With On-demand Schema Linking (OSL), MEM-SQL consults the schema only when no layer qualifies or the generator judges retrieved evidence insufficient. Across six language models on HARE, mean execution accuracy rises from 37.1% for Direct Generation without history to 50.0% for MEM-SQL, with 76.6% fewer input tokens and 68.8% lower latency on average. Further analysis shows that requests reusing several verified queries remain a bottleneck, with accuracy falling from 56.7% to 29.7%, most sharply when reused components must be placed in a new query structure or combined with a shared join. Applying OSL to three other memory designs consistently reduces generation cost, while its accuracy benefit depends on the memory design. Verified history can thus make generation both more accurate and cheaper, but its value depends on the evidence retained and when the system consults the schema.
hf.titleZh: MEM-SQL:记忆增强的Text-to-SQL
hf.summaryZh: 针对现有Text-to-SQL基准独立评估每个问题、忽略同一数据库上历史查询可复用连接与计算的缺陷，构建了HARE基准:包含来自4个数据集、823条已验证查询衍生的1,600个请求，并标注每条请求保留与修改的组件。提出MEM-SQL，分层存储整查询模板、可复用SQL块与领域概念到schema元素的映射，仅当某层所有需求均超过阈值时才启用该层，并在无层可用或生成器判断证据不足时才触发按需schema linking。在6个语言模型上，HARE的平均执行准确率由无历史的直接生成37.1%提升至50.0%，输入token减少76.6%、延迟降低68.8%。分析显示复用多条已验证查询的请求仍是瓶颈(准确率从56.7%降至29.7%)，且OSL的降本效果稳定但准确率收益依赖记忆设计。
hf.reason: Text-to-SQL记忆复用与按需schema linking，属LLM工具/Agent擦边方向

hf.title: JVT: Just Video Transformer makes pixel-space video diffusion simple
hf.abstract: Direct diffusion modeling of high-dimensional raw video data is challenging, and existing pixel-space methods often rely on specialized architectures. We introduce JVT (Just Video Transformer), a simple large-patch DiT-style Transformer for pixel-space video diffusion, without a pretrained autoencoder, auxiliary detailers, cascaded stages, or U-Net-style skip connections. We systematically examine video patch embeddings, register tokens, and adaptive layer normalization to identify design choices that balance generation quality and computational efficiency. The resulting JVT design achieves generation quality competitive with latent diffusion baselines in both class-conditioned and unconditional settings. The pixel-space formulation of JVT also naturally supports joint generation of pixel-aligned modalities. We demonstrate this capability through camera-conditioned RGB-disparity generation, which improves camera following relative to RGB-only baselines and yields explicit scene geometry without an additional reconstruction model at inference. These results highlight the potential of simple DiT-style Transformers for pixel-space video diffusion, and we hope our findings offer useful insights and practical guidance for future research.
hf.titleZh: JVT：仅用视频 Transformer 即可实现简单的像素空间视频扩散
hf.summaryZh: 直接在像素空间扩散建模高维原始视频数据很困难，现有方法多依赖专用架构。JVT 用大 patch 的 DiT 式 Transformer 直接建模像素视频，去掉预训练自编码器、辅助细节网络、级联阶段与 U-Net 式跳连，并系统考察视频 patch 嵌入、register token 与自适应层归一化的设计取舍。在类别条件与无条件生成下，其质量与潜空间扩散基线相当；像素对齐的特性还支持相机条件 RGB-视差联合生成，相机跟随优于仅 RGB 基线，推理时无需额外重建模型即可获得显式场景几何。
hf.reason: 像素空间视频扩散，属视频生成方向，与关注方向无交集

hf.title: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
hf.abstract: Web agents powered by large language and vision-language models are increasingly applied to realistic browser work that spans heterogeneous applications, multimodal content, and stateful workflows. However, existing reproducible web-agent benchmarks cover only a small number of web applications drawn from a few software categories, and restrict modality to text and vision. Live benchmarks broaden site coverage but sacrifice reproducibility, since pages and data drift between runs. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not meaningfully evaluate whether agents can understand and use audio and video content embedded within web tasks. To address these gaps, we introduce WebArena-Pro, a benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 20 self-hosted web applications in six domain categories, spanning distinct interface conventions, workflows, and data models. Across the evaluated agents, the best performance is achieved by both Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 at 62.3%, followed by OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro at 60.7%. The strongest GenericAgent configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro omni and Gemma4 31B, both achieve 30.3%. Among reproducible, human-curated web agent benchmarks, WebArena-Pro provides the broadest application coverage and the most comprehensive multimodal support to date. The benchmark treats audio and video as core observations alongside text and vision, with dedicated actions for extracting information from each. WebArena-Pro runs each task in isolation and supports reproducible, parallel evaluation. Tasks are authored through a dedicated annotator interface, filtered by LLM-assisted triage, and finally validated by humans before release. Project page: https://webarena-pro.github.io
hf.titleZh: WebArena-Pro:一个异构、多模态、可复现的Web Agent基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有可复现的web agent基准只覆盖少数类别的少量应用，模态也限于文本与视觉;在线基准虽然覆盖更多站点，却牺牲了可复现性;而且这些基准都没有真正评测agent能否理解网页中的音频、视频内容。WebArena-Pro在6个类别、20个自托管web应用上构建了300个任务，覆盖异构的界面约定、工作流与数据模型，把音频、视频和文本、视觉并列为核心观测，并为每类模态设计了专门的信息抽取动作;任务先由标注人员通过一个专用标注界面撰写，再经LLM辅助筛选和人工校验，最终支持隔离运行、并行且可复现的评测。最佳配置Codex配GPT 6.1 Sol和Claude Code配Claude Opus 5.5均达62.3%，最强的GenericAgent配置仅30.3%。
hf.reason: 面向Web Agent的异构多模态可复现基准，直接命中Agent与评测方向

hf.title: eDMD: Endpoint Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation
hf.abstract: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) has emerged as a leading paradigm for distilling diffusion models into few-step students, where an auxiliary fake score model tracks the student's distribution and the discrepancy between the teacher and fake predictions drives the student toward the teacher. In multi-step distillation, although only the student's final output is delivered, existing methods train the fake model on intermediate states or across all denoising steps. Consequently, the student's update signal becomes entangled with intermediate distributions, which can distort the matching direction and remain nonzero even after the student's final outputs already match the teacher distribution. To resolve this mismatch, we propose Endpoint Distribution Matching Distillation (eDMD), which trains a single shared fake model exclusively on the student's final outputs and uses it to correct every denoising step. Our theoretical analysis proves that this endpoint reference guarantees that the distribution matching term vanishes if and only if the student's final output distribution matches the teacher's, regardless of intermediate distributions. Beyond the fake reference, we further strengthen teacher supervision through a precise teacher (PT) that replaces single-step guided predictions with short multi-step trajectories on the final noise interval, paired with a calibrated query density for intermediate steps. Experiments on SD3-Medium, FLUX.2-klein (4B and 9B), and Qwen-Image-2.1 demonstrate that eDMD consistently outperforms existing distribution matching methods for 4-step generation.
hf.titleZh: eDMD:端点分布匹配的少步扩散蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: DMD类蒸馏在多变步训练时，把辅助假评分模型建在中间状态或全部去噪步上，导致学生模型的更新信号混入中间分布，匹配方向被扭曲，即便最终输出已对齐教师分布，该匹配项仍不为零。eDMD改为只在学生的最终输出上训练一个共享假模型，并用它为每个去噪步提供校正，理论上证明该端点参考下分布匹配项消失当且仅当最终输出分布与教师一致;同时用最终噪声区间上的短多步轨迹构成精确教师来替代单步引导预测，并为中间步校准查询密度。在SD3-Medium、FLUX.2-klein(4B与9B)与Qwen-Image-2.1上，4步生成稳定优于现有分布匹配方法。
hf.reason: 扩散图像生成蒸馏，属低分方向

hf.title: GH-AWTrace: A Large-Scale Dataset of GitHub Agentic Workflow Execution Logs
hf.abstract: Agentic workflows enable AI agents to perform recurring repository tasks on schedules or in response to repository events. Existing studies examine workflow definitions and outputs, but provide limited evidence of what happens during execution. We present GH-AWTrace, a dataset linking 25,014 verified GitHub Agentic Workflows across 5,051 repositories to 4,112,526 run records and 562,877 nonempty execution log archives. The dataset preserves execution evidence subject to GitHub's log-retention limits and links it to repository metadata and generated workflow configurations. Illustrative cases show how the logs expose tool denials, provider failures, changes in an agent's approach, and delegation among agents. These observations enable research on execution failures, tool use, and the relationship between reported run outcomes and visible task progress. Coverage varies across workflows, and the logs provide partial observations rather than complete agent trajectories. Video: https://youtu.be/KIlfmZhHxtA
hf.titleZh: GH-AWTrace：大规模 GitHub Agentic Workflow 执行日志数据集
hf.summaryZh: 现有研究多停留在 Agentic Workflow 的定义与最终输出，缺少执行过程证据。该工作构建 GH-AWTrace，将 5,051 个仓库中的 25,014 个经校验的 GitHub Agentic Workflow 与 4,112,526 条运行记录、562,877 份非空执行日志归档关联，并保留仓库元数据与生成的 workflow 配置。案例显示日志可揭示工具调用被拒、模型服务商故障、Agent 策略切换与多 Agent 委派等现象。数据可用于研究执行失败、工具使用以及运行状态与实际任务进展的偏差，但受 GitHub 日志保留期限制，覆盖不均衡且轨迹仅为部分观测。
hf.reason: Agent 工作流执行日志数据集，贴合 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: Interpreting Coding Agents Through Their Behavioral Trajectories
hf.abstract: Standard coding-agent benchmarks primarily evaluate binary task success, treating execution as a black box and obscuring the behaviors that produce those outcomes. We analyze a large corpus of 143,209 execution trajectories from 125 agent configurations spanning 117 unique models. To enable comparisons across heterogeneous agent interfaces, we develop a rule-based parser that maps raw execution traces to high-level actions such as repository search, file editing, and test execution, and audit its predictions against a six-model consensus reference on 500 events. We find that agents with similar solve rates can nevertheless differ substantially in how they explore, modify and verify code. Moreover, without using task outcomes, token counts, or tool names as features, aggregate behavioral profiles retrieve the corresponding agent stack across disjoint repository sets and programming languages, although task composition is not fully controlled in the cross-repository setting. Through analyses of frontier models and agent scaffolds, we further show that scaffold choice and reasoning effort systematically shift agents' search, editing, and testing behavior. We release the deterministic parser together with the full annotation and analysis pipeline alongside an annotated trajectory subset.
hf.titleZh: 通过行为轨迹解读编程智能体
hf.summaryZh: 标准编程智能体基准多以任务成败论英雄，把执行过程当黑箱，掩盖了产生结果的行为差异。该工作收集117个模型、125种智能体配置共143209条执行轨迹，用规则解析器将原始轨迹归并为仓库搜索、文件编辑、测试执行等高层动作，并在500个事件上与六模型共识标注比对校验。结果显示:解题率相近的智能体在探索、修改与验证代码的方式上差异显著;不使用任务结果、token数与工具名作特征，聚合行为画像仍能在不同仓库集合与编程语言间匹配到对应的智能体技术栈;脚手架选择与推理投入也会系统性改变搜索、编辑与测试行为。作者开源确定性解析器、完整标注分析流程及标注轨迹子集，为智能体行为评测提供可复用的方法学基础。
hf.reason: 编程智能体行为分析，大规模轨迹与方法学，直接命中Agent与代码智能

hf.title: CANTraj: Recovering Vehicle Trajectories from CAN Signals in Naturalistic Driving
hf.abstract: Open driving releases and usage-based insurance programs often claim to prevent privacy breaches by omitting GPS records when sharing or collecting vehicle data. However, removing GPS coordinates from driving logs does not erase the location information carried by vehicle signals. While prior route-inference attacks have demonstrated that speed, steering, and driving events can be matched to road networks to reconstruct trajectories, existing studies rely on inconsistent prior assumptions and evaluation metrics and are tested only on small, restricted datasets, making their results difficult to compare and their real-world effectiveness uncertain. We release CANTraj, a naturalistic driving dataset pairing decoded CAN events with time-aligned GNSS trajectories (3,940 drives, 454 drivers), and CANTraj-Bench for evaluating trajectory recovery (3,675 drives, 431 drivers, 1,380 hours, 85,919 km). On 776 evaluation drives from 94 unseen drivers, we compare six re-implemented attacks and benchmark baselines under explicit information-access protocols, paired comparisons, and metrics incorporating failures. Experiments show that combining steering signals with road-network constraints yields the largest gain: With a known start and heading, adding steering to speed raises the online map filter's five-minute route recovery from 56% to 87%, with a median average displacement error of 43 m versus 921 m for map-free dead reckoning. Offline beam search recovers 88% of test routes with the heading and 81% without it. Because methods fail on different windows, we also evaluate an LLM harness that selects among candidate routes on 659 five-minute windows; its best configuration recovers 79% of routes on test and 83% on few-shot, outperforming the best baseline on test and matching it on few-shot. Data and code at huggingface.co/datasets/HenryYHW/CANTraj and github.com/WangYuHang-cmd/GPS--CAN.
hf.titleZh: CANTraj：从自然驾驶的 CAN 信号中恢复车辆轨迹
hf.summaryZh: 去除 GPS 记录并不等于消除位置隐私：车辆 CAN 信号中的速度、转向与驾驶事件仍可与路网匹配，从而重建行驶路线。为此发布 CANTraj 自然驾驶数据集（3,940 次行程、454 名驾驶员），并构建评测轨迹恢复的 CANTraj-Bench（3,675 次行程、1,380 小时、85,919 km），在统一的信息访问协议与配对比较下重实现并对比六种攻击方法。结果显示：将转向信号与路网约束结合带来的增益最大，在已知起点与朝向时，在线地图滤波的 5 分钟路线恢复率由 56% 提升至 87%，中位平均位移误差 43 m，而无地图航位推算为 921 m；离线束搜索在已知和未知朝向时分别恢复 88% 与 81% 的路线；此外还评估了一个 LLM harness，在候选路线间做选择，最佳配置在测试集恢复 79%、少样本下 83%。
hf.reason: 车辆信号隐私攻击数据集，仅擦边 LLM，偏离主线方向

hf.title: Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime
hf.abstract: Agent harnesses have emerged as a promising mechanism for continual learning, alongside test-time parametric learning. However, the current benchmarks have several limitations: they generally focus on a single applied domain, serve each instance only once, and assume a single family of learner, so memory-based and weight-based systems are rarely compared on the same scale. We propose Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream built from the three ARC-AGI editions, whose tasks need no domain knowledge. The same tasks return after dormant gaps with fresh instances, while new tasks keep arriving. On each instance, the learner may pay for demonstrations, submit answers, or act inside the harness, with retries permitted on incorrect submissions, which are paid for. Each instance is scored based on the share of this feedback budget consumed. Since a learner may keep anything between instances, memory-based and weight-based systems are scored on the same scale. After the stream, the learner is frozen and tested on fresh instances of the tasks it met, which measures memorization, and on unseen tasks, which measures generalization. We run an agent harness with frozen weights, with and without persistence, on Qwen3.5-9B and GLM-5.3 Flash, comparing them with two prompting floors, a program-induction method and Qwen3.5-9B's weights trained to imitate GLM-5.3 Flash. Persistence in the harness generally does not improve memorization unless provided with explicit expert guidance. Most harness-based methods still learn less than a floor that simply caches each task's demonstrations, across all models we tested. No harness-based method gains on unseen tasks, whereas weight-based learning shows substantial gains. This opens the door to future weight-based continual learning that could teach models to drive harnesses in new domains.
hf.titleZh: Continual-ARC:衡量整个工作生命周期内的技能习得
hf.summaryZh: 现有持续学习基准多局限于单一应用领域、每个实例只出现一次，且只支持一类学习器，使基于记忆与基于权重的系统难以在同一尺度上比较。Continual-ARC 用三届 ARC-AGI 题目构建无需领域知识的终身数据流:同一任务在休眠间隔后以新实例回归，新任务持续到来;学习器可付费购买示例、提交答案或在 harness 内行动，答错重试也要付费，得分取决于反馈预算的消耗比例。在 Qwen3.5-9B 与 GLM-5.3 Flash 上运行冻结权重的 agent harness 显示，除非给出显式专家指导，harness 的持久化并不提升记忆，多数 harness 方法不如“缓存每个任务示例”的基线，在未见任务上也无增益，而基于权重的学习提升显著。
hf.reason: 持续学习基准，统一比较 agent harness 与权重学习，方法学扎实

hf.title: Aligning AI Teams
hf.abstract: Previous work has shown that alignment training on individual LLM agents can fail to transfer to multi-agent settings. We investigate the underlying mechanisms for this failure, and explore interventions to preserve alignment transfer to multi-agent LLM teams. We focus on two software-engineering tasks (sepsis triage, a news recommender) and ten consulting-proposal generation tasks. We present four findings: (1) The single-vs-team safety gap does not show a clear trend with more capable models. We find that Anthropic's Mythos Preview shows the largest gap on one of our tasks but the smallest on another; (2) Many natural interventions, such as having agents critique each other's work or coordinate in a group chat, do not reliably bring agent teams back to single-agent alignment behavior; (3) diffusion of responsibility substantially accounts for the safety gap: agents in teams are less likely to proactively check for system-level safety failures and more likely to ignore, rationalize, or deflect responsibility for issues when they arise; (4) having a designated safety lead agent ensure system-level safety, and having a coordinator agent publish a safety specifications document are effective at restoring single-agent alignment. We also release magelab, a multi-agent LLM orchestration and experimentation framework. Our findings can help practitioners design agent teams that successfully preserve the behaviors expected of aligned individual agents.
hf.titleZh: 对齐 AI 团队
hf.summaryZh: 单智能体上的对齐训练难以迁移到多智能体团队，这里聚焦失效机制与干预手段：在脓毒症分诊、新闻推荐两个软件工程任务和十个咨询提案生成任务上，对比单智能体与团队的安全行为。结果显示，安全差距并不随模型能力提升而单调缩小，Mythos Preview在其中一个任务上差距最大、在另一个任务上最小；互相批评、群聊协调等自然干预无法稳定恢复单智能体行为，责任分散是主要成因——团队成员更少主动检查系统级安全故障，更倾向忽视或推诿问题。指定安全负责人负责系统级安全、由协调者发布安全规范文档，可有效恢复单智能体级别的对齐，同时开源多智能体编排与实验框架magelab。
hf.reason: 多智能体对齐迁移机制与干预，属于Agent与对齐交叉的扎实工作

hf.title: AI Reviews Are Biased Towards the Appendix
hf.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by reviewers to highlight weaknesses during the reviewing process, and their outputs often shape the reviews that humans submit. Prior work studies how LLM reviews align with human ones, yet we know little about which parts of a paper these models actually criticize. In this work, we investigate 2,000 papers from ACL, EMNLP, COLM, and ICLR, and show that the latest GPT and Claude models draw about 50% or more of their review weaknesses from the appendix. This behavior holds across the API, coding-agent, and web access methods for using LLMs to review a paper. In contrast, we find that humans draw only 8.4% of their weaknesses from the appendix, and these weaknesses primarily revolve around a paper's presentation and content related to its core idea. Meanwhile, LLMs draw weaknesses from deep in the appendix that concern fine-grained technical details not central to the paper's contributions. We anticipate that our analysis will contribute to the scholarly discourse on AI reviews. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/cincynlp/review_appendix.
hf.titleZh: AI 评审偏向附录
hf.summaryZh: 以ACL、EMNLP、COLM与ICLR的2000篇论文为样本，统计发现最新GPT与Claude模型生成的评审弱点中约50%以上来自附录，而人类评审的这一比例仅为8.4%。人类弱点主要围绕论文表述与核心思想，LLM则从附录深处挖掘与核心贡献无关的细粒度技术细节。该偏差在API调用、coding agent与网页访问三种使用方式下均稳定存在，提示LLM辅助审稿需关注证据来源分布。
hf.reason: LLM-as-judge偏差实证分析，属评测方法学，数据扎实

hf.title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
hf.abstract: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. From a single representation space, Bonbon exhibits three zero-shot emergent capabilities at hierarchical levels of resolution: functional (mechanism of action), residue (binding site localization, including orthosteric/allosteric discrimination), and bond (covalent versus non-covalent engagement). All three capabilities generalize to out-of-distribution complexes. Bonbon was trained on protein-ligand sequences alone, without any task-specific supervision and without structural coordinates. We conducted controlled scaling experiments across six model scales from 42M to 1.6B parameters; every capability evaluated shows a sharp jump at the largest scale on continuous metrics, even as pretraining loss decreases smoothly. This demonstrates that loss-based scaling laws alone are insufficient to predict when zero-shot emergent capabilities become available. The capabilities reported here emerge after training at a 1:2,000 parameter-to-token ratio to accommodate the sparsity of paired biological interaction data. The same frozen representations achieve state-of-the-art binding and affinity prediction at five orders of magnitude greater speed than co-folding methods. In prospective wet-lab validation across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families, Bonbon achieves a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds, yielding structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets.
hf.titleZh: 分子相互作用基础模型中的涌现生物学能力
hf.summaryZh: 面向蛋白质-配体相互作用，构建多模态生物基础模型 Bonbon，在约3.2万亿 token 的配对蛋白-配体序列上预训练，不使用结构坐标与任务监督。单一表征空间在零样本下呈现三个层级的能力:功能层的作用机制判别、残基层的结合位点定位(含正构/变构区分)、键层的共价与非共价结合识别，且可泛化到分布外复合物。在42M至1.6B六个规模上的控制实验显示，各项能力仅在最大规模处出现陡增，而预训练损失平滑下降，说明仅凭损失标度律无法预测涌现能力何时出现;冻结表征在结合与亲和力预测上达到 SOTA，速度比联合折叠方法快五个数量级。九个疾病靶点的湿实验验证中，de novo 化合物剂量-反应命中率为61.5%。
hf.reason: 生物分子基础模型，涌现与标度律分析有借鉴，但属生物信息学低分方向

hf.title: HALO: Human-Aligned Data Collection for WhoLe-body MObile Manipulation
hf.abstract: Learning whole-body mobile manipulation requires demonstrations that coordinate bimanual actions with locomotion across extended workspaces. However, existing interfaces trade off direct robot control, perception and action alignment, and natural operator mobility, making such demonstrations difficult to collect. We introduce HALO, a human-aligned data collection system for whole-body mobile manipulation. The system aligns the operator's perception and action space with the robot while preserving direct physical feedback and natural locomotion. Operators guide the robot end-effectors through kinesthetic teaching and move a low-resistance platform without the deployed mobile base while performing bimanual manipulation. This interface enables more natural whole-body demonstrations, but the close human-robot coupling introduces discrepancies between the demonstration and deployment settings. We address these discrepancies with deployment-aligned demonstration processing, which calibrates and temporally aligns platform motion with the deployed base response and masks and inpaints demonstrator hands in recorded observations. Compared with Mobile ALOHA and VR teleoperation, HALO enables up to 2.9x faster demonstration collection while maintaining comparable or higher success rates. Policies trained with HALO perform precise manipulation tasks, including zip-tie fastening, and achieve a 73.3% success rate on a six-stage long-horizon mobile manipulation task involving repeated coordinated base and arm motion. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/Lingbot-ALOHA/
hf.titleZh: HALO：面向全身移动操作的人类对齐数据采集系统
hf.summaryZh: 全身移动操作需要双臂操作与移动协调一致的示范数据，而现有采集接口难以兼顾直接控制、感知-动作对齐与操作者自然移动。HALO让操作者以动觉示教引导机器人末端执行器，并推动低阻力平台代替真实移动底盘，从而在保留物理反馈与自然行走的同时对齐操作者与机器人的感知-动作空间；针对人机紧耦合带来的示范-部署差异，系统再用部署对齐处理校准并时间对齐平台运动与真实底盘响应，并对观测中的示教者手部做掩码与修复。相比Mobile ALOHA与VR遥操作，示范采集速度最高提升2.9倍且成功率相当或更高，训练出的策略可完成扎带紧固等精细任务，并在涉及底盘与机械臂反复协同的六阶段长程任务上达到73.3%成功率。
hf.reason: 全身移动操作数据采集接口，属数据规模化擦边方向

hf.title: Re-Search: Dissecting LLM Ideation Through a Two-Player Questioning Game
hf.abstract: Research ideation is iterative: researchers refine their ideas step by step based on feedback. Yet existing evaluations obscure this search process, making it difficult to understand how LLMs explore the space of research ideas and what limits their progress. We introduce Re-Search, which adapts the format of Twenty Questions to research ideation: given only the research problem of a published paper, a model must rediscover the paper's core idea by asking yes-or-no questions. Built from 200 ICML 2026 papers, Re-Search tracks how a model's idea evolves as it asks questions and receives binary oracle feedback, isolating ideation from execution. Across six recent LLMs, nearly all progress happens within the first 30 of 100 questions, which largely decide how the game ends; after that, most models plateau. Through controlled interventions on the candidate questions and the hypothesis space, we find that the bottleneck is generation, not judgment: models recognize a good idea or a good question when one is offered, but often cannot produce it on their own. We further analyze the ideation traces and find that models fail by either over-exploiting one direction or over-exploring too many. These findings point to concrete design principles for autoresearch systems: since models can judge candidates they cannot produce, enriching the search with externally sourced ideas and questions may be more effective than improving any single model's generation ability.
hf.titleZh: Re-Search:用双人提问游戏剖析LLM的构想过程
hf.summaryZh: 研究构想本是迭代过程，现有评测却掩盖了这一搜索路径，难以看清LLM如何探索想法空间、瓶颈在哪里。Re-Search把二十问游戏改造成构想评测:只给已发表论文的研究问题，模型需通过是/否提问并获得二元反馈来重新发现论文核心想法，数据取自200篇ICML 2026论文，构想与执行被分离。六个近期LLM上，几乎全部进展集中在前30问(共100问)，之后普遍停滞;干预实验显示瓶颈在生成而非判别，模型能认出好想法与好问题却难以自主产出。轨迹分析显示失败模式为过度利用单一方向或过度探索过多方向，提示auto research系统应引入外部想法与问题来丰富搜索。
hf.reason: AI for Research评测，用二十问范式定位构想瓶颈，方法扎实

hf.title: Evidence-Governed Adoption of Self-Generated Updates in Autonomous AI Agents
hf.abstract: Autonomous agents modify prompts, memories, tools, workflows, and policies using interaction histories. Yet a plausible modification is not necessarily suitable for persistent adoption: candidate selection is adaptive, evaluators may be imperfect, and local gains can hide degradation against an earlier baseline. We introduce Evidence-Governed Evolution (EGE), a framework for governing adoption of self-generated agent modifications. EGE separates candidate generation from confirmatory adoption, evaluates frozen candidates on fresh paired audits, requires meaningful improvement on a prespecified primary objective, protects declared capabilities through reference-relative non-inferiority tests, and applies governance constraints before bounded canary deployment. We establish an evaluator-calibrated simultaneous lower-bound construction for a countable sequence of adaptively generated candidates. It combines candidate-wise Hoeffding bounds with independent calibration samples comparing the operational evaluator with a prespecified reference procedure. We also formalise reference replacement through bridge tests, derive a cumulative degradation bound along a versioned reference lineage, and provide an audit-planning condition relating effect-size margin, sample sizes, and acceptance probability. A Monte Carlo stress test illustrates calibration under candidate-dependent evaluator optimism; it is a stylised statistical experiment, not an evaluation of a deployed agent. The guarantees are conditional on bounded paired scores, fresh sampling, a valid reference-evaluation construct, and declared evaluation distributions; they do not establish universal agent safety or robustness to arbitrary distribution shift.
hf.titleZh: 自主 AI Agent 中自生成更新的证据治理式采纳
hf.summaryZh: 自主 Agent 会依据交互历史改写 prompt、记忆、工具、工作流与策略，但看似合理的改动未必适合长期保留：候选由自适应搜索产生、评估器存在偏差、局部提升可能掩盖相对早期基线的退化。Evidence-Governed Evolution（EGE）把候选生成与确认性采纳分离，在新鲜配对审计上评估冻结候选，要求在预设主目标上取得实质提升，并用参照相对非劣性检验保护已声明能力，最后才进入有界的金丝雀部署。论文给出针对可数自适应候选序列的评估器校准同时下界构造（候选级 Hoeffding 界结合独立校准样本），形式化参照替换的桥接检验与沿版本参照谱系的累积退化界，并给出关联效应量裕度、样本量与接受概率的审计规划条件。蒙特卡洛压力测试展示了候选依赖的评估器乐观下的校准行为，属于统计演示而非真实部署评估；对 Agent 自进化与评测可靠性研究有方法学参考价值。
hf.reason: Agent 自我改进的采纳治理与评估校准，方法学扎实但缺真实实证

hf.title: Disen-Forcing: Disentangling Semantic Anchoring from Motion for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
hf.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models (AR-VDMs) enable real-time, long-horizon video generation but degrade rapidly once the inference horizon outruns the training horizon, due to compounding exposure bias. To stabilize long rollouts, recent methods heuristically adopt frame sink, keeping initial frames as a persistent model context, inspired by attention sinks in LLMs. We revisit this design and find that the mechanism by which initial frames stabilize long-range consistency in AR-VDMs is not an LLM-style attention sink; instead, long-range consistency is anchored through a sparse subset of attention heads, while the majority of heads predominantly capture local temporal dynamics. This observation reveals an over-conditioning pathology in existing frame-sink strategies: by universally exposing every head to the pinned initial-frame context, the model becomes prone to collapsing motion toward the low-dynamic modes of the teacher during model distillation. We propose Disen-Forcing, a distillation-time plug-in for AR-VDMs that disentangles and reinforces this head specialization through disentangled context routing and motion-disentangling regularization. On long-horizon video generation benchmarks, Disen-Forcing simultaneously improves long-range consistency and motion dynamics of base AR-VDMs, a trade-off that sink-based methods fail to balance.
hf.titleZh: Disen-Forcing:为自回归视频扩散解耦语义锚定与运动
hf.summaryZh: 自回归视频扩散模型在推理长度超出训练长度后，会因累积的曝光偏差而迅速退化;近期工作借鉴 LLM 的 attention sink，把首帧固定为持久上下文以稳定长程生成。本文重新审视该设计，发现首帧稳定长程一致性的机制并非 LLM 式注意力汇，而是由稀疏的一部分注意力头承担远程锚定，多数头则主要捕捉局部时序动态。据此提出的 Disen-Forcing 是一种蒸馏阶段插件，通过解耦的上下文路由与运动解耦正则强化上述头部特化，避免全体注意力头都被首帧过度条件化、导致蒸馏中运动塌缩到教师的低动态模式。在长程视频生成基准上，该方法同时提升了基础模型的长程一致性与运动动态性，缓解了 sink 类方法无法兼顾的权衡。
hf.reason: 视频扩散生成，属低分方向，仅蒸馏与注意力机制略沾边

hf.title: eDIAR: Training-Free Open-Speaker Streaming Diarization for Long Meetings and Large Archives via e-means
hf.abstract: Meetings last up to an hour, and nobody knows in advance how many people will speak. Neural diarizers with a fixed number of output slots, such as Streaming Sortformer and Nemotron-3, are accurate and run online, but they cannot name more speakers than they have slots. We remove this limit without retraining. The slot head keeps deciding who is active and when speech overlaps, and speaker embeddings are clustered inside a single slot, with the official e-means algorithm, only after every slot has been used. In the streaming system, re-clustering is confined to a bounded window, labels are revised for a few seconds, and identities are anchored to the slots of the head. The resulting system has no limit on the number of speakers and stays accurate when speakers outnumber the slots, where fixed-slot models break down. On meetings that grow to an hour it stays far more accurate than Streaming Sortformer, which accumulates errors, and its cost per update does not grow with the meeting. The same recipe turns the four-slot Streaming Sortformer into an open-speaker system. Across recordings, e-means makes it affordable to link the speakers of a large archive frame by frame, a task that arises when conversational corpora are prepared, and it reaches the clustering quality of Lloyd's k-means several times faster. The method needs little tuning, and e-means runs with its default recipe from a few hundred to more than a million embeddings.
hf.titleZh: eDIAR：面向长会议与大型档案、基于 e-means 的免训练开放说话人流式说话人分离
hf.summaryZh: 固定槽位的流式说话人分离模型（如 Streaming Sortformer、Nemotron-3）槽位用完就无法标注更多说话人。eDIAR 不改模型、不重训练：槽头继续判断谁在说话与重叠情况，当所有槽位用尽后，用官方 e-means 算法在单个槽内对说话人嵌入聚类；流式场景下把重聚类限制在有界窗口内，标签回溯修订数秒，身份锚定到槽头。系统说话人数不再受限，在说话人数超过槽位数时仍保持准确，一小时会议上的准确率远高于误差累积的 Streaming Sortformer，且单次更新开销不随会议时长增长；档案级逐帧说话人链接达到 Lloyd's k-means 的聚类质量且快数倍。
hf.reason: 流式说话人分离属语音应用，仅聚类方法略沾边

hf.title: JFinBench: A Continuously Refreshable Japanese Financial Benchmark from the Latest Certification Exams
hf.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to finance, creating a need for benchmarks that evaluate their capabilities across financial systems with different regulations and practices. However, existing financial benchmarks provide limited coverage of country-specific financial systems, and they are difficult to keep up to date as released questions leak into training data. We introduce JFinBench, a Japanese financial benchmark comprising 321 examples from the 2026 editions of six regularly administered certification exams covering accounting, tax, financial planning, and banking. To construct it, we develop a human-in-the-loop agentic pipeline in which a coding agent writes exam-specific conversion code and a review page, while a human verifies every example and feeds corrections back to the agent. This pipeline adapts to heterogeneous exam formats and reduces the effort of incorporating new exam editions, enabling periodic refreshes that mitigate data contamination. Evaluating 12 recent LLMs, we find that Claude Fable 5 and GPT-6 Astra exceed 93% overall, while even the best open-weight model, Kimi K3.1 Pro, trails Claude Fable 5 by 12 percentage points. When models can additionally use a terminal and web access, they retrieve the knowledge they lack and every model improves. The gap narrows but about 4 points remain, and the ranking of models stays largely the same, suggesting that knowledge held in the model itself remains valuable even with tools. We release the dataset, the evaluation code, and the construction pipeline.
hf.titleZh: JFinBench：基于最新认证考试的可持续刷新日语金融基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有金融基准对国家特定金融体系覆盖不足，且题目一旦泄漏进训练数据便难以保持时效。JFinBench 从 2026 年六项定期认证考试（会计、税务、金融理财、银行）收集 321 道题，用人类在环的 agentic 流水线构建：编码 agent 编写考试专用的格式转换代码与审核页面，人工逐题校验并将修正反馈给 agent，从而适配异构考卷格式、降低纳入新考季的成本。评测 12 个近期 LLM，Claude Fable 5 与 GPT-6 Astra 总体超过 93%，最强开源模型 Kimi K3.1 Pro 落后 12 个百分点；开放终端与联网后所有模型均有提升，差距缩窄但仍余约 4 点且排名基本不变，说明模型自身知识仍具价值。
hf.reason: 金融垂域基准，agentic 构建流水线有新意，但规模偏小

hf.title: Do Underwater Image Quality Metrics Agree with Human Perception? A Benchmark with Human Choices, Simple Edits and Generative Drift
hf.abstract: Underwater image enhancement is challenging to evaluate due to the lack of clean reference images, so researchers rely on no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA) metrics. However, it remains unclear whether these metrics agree with human judgments. We evaluate 73 handcrafted underwater, learned underwater, vision-language and general-purpose metrics against human preferences on five references: four published opinion-score sets and a new paired-comparison study. For each metric, we measure how often it selects the same image as people when comparing versions of the same scene. We further test whether simple image edits and small adversarial perturbations raise metric scores above the enhancement people preferred, and whether scores decrease as repeated generative edits add noise. Our results show that no metric consistently matches human preferences. The best worst-case Cohen's kappa over the five references is only 0.23 (Q-Align), while two raters in our study agree with a median kappa of 0.41. The widely used UCIQE often favors edits that people reject. On a Nano Banana Pro replica chain that should leave the image unchanged, only 22 of 73 scores decrease at every checkpoint, while noise grows by 2.5 times. We also introduce TrustUIQA, a benchmark that combines the human references, our study choices, the edited, attacked and generated images, and the scores of every metric on every image. The code is available at https://github.com/TrustUIQA/TrustUIQA and TrustUIQA at https://huggingface.co/datasets/TrustUIQA/TrustUIQA.
hf.titleZh: 水下图像质量指标与人类感知一致吗?一个包含人类选择、简单编辑与生成漂移的基准
hf.summaryZh: 水下图像增强缺乏干净参考图，研究者依赖无参考图像质量评价(NR-IQA)指标，但这些指标是否与人类判断一致尚不清楚。该工作在四组已发表意见分数据与一组新的成对比较研究共五个参考上，评测了73种手工设计、学习式水下指标、视觉语言与通用指标，衡量它们在同一场景版本比较中与人类选择一致的比例，并检验简单编辑与微小对抗扰动能否把指标分数抬到人类偏好的增强结果之上，以及重复生成编辑累积噪声时分数是否下降。结果显示没有指标能稳定匹配人类偏好:五组参考上最差情形Cohen's kappa最高仅0.23(Q-Align)，而该研究中两名标注者之间的中位kappa为0.41;常用的UCIQE常偏向人类拒绝的编辑;在应保持图像不变的Nano Banana Pro复刻链上，73个指标中仅22个在每个检查点分数都下降，而噪声增长了2.5倍。作者发布TrustUIQA基准，汇集人类参考、选择记录、编辑/攻击/生成图像及各指标打分，可用于诊断NR-IQA指标的可靠性。
hf.reason: 水下图像增强质量评价基准，属低分垂直领域

hf.title: Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing
hf.abstract: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length. Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.
hf.titleZh: 解析正确、看似合理却错误：输出格式控制小模型语义解析中的静默错误
hf.summaryZh: 小模型解析器会输出格式合法但语义错误的树，且这种失败是静默的，下游难以察觉。在 PIZZA 点单基准上，用 LoRA 微调 Qwen3.5-0.8B 与 LFM2.5-350M，对同一目标树的六种无损编码做 300 次对照运行，并预注册层级 bootstrap 与 Holm 校正。单纯缩短长度从不带来收益，而改用普通词书写目标最准确：Qwen 上精确匹配 87.5%（原生 s-expression 为 85.8%），token 少 4.1 倍，静默错误率降 2.3 倍（LFM2 降 1.8 倍），增益多来自否定结构；模型还学会拒识菜单外输入（95.9–99.0%），代价是 2.1–10.1% 的真实礼貌订单被拒。对结构化输出的格式设计与静默错误评估有参考价值。
hf.reason: 小模型结构化输出格式研究，方向擦边、任务较窄

arxiv.title: Latent Lattice Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. Unlike hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures, whose recurrent states primarily serve as internal memory for sequence mixing, these latents directly condition the vertical stream's attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. On Transformers trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406M-parameter Lattice model lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 over a parameter-matched Transformer. These gains extend across architectural variants. The Lattice composes with prior residual-stream enhancements: with hyper-connections and input residuals, it lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 (base Transformer) and 14.22 (Transformer with the same enhancements) to 13.61. On Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, Triadic GDN, and GDN-Mamba-2 hybrids, it improves perplexity at every tested native state size, with Lattice-GDN and Lattice-Triadic-GDN variants outperforming pure baselines with 4x larger native states. These results identify persistent per-layer state as a complementary axis for scaling language-model computation.
arxiv.titleZh: 潜在格语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 提出 Latent Lattice（潜在格）：为每层增加横向、跨 token 持续存在的潜在状态流，与纵向残差流并行，并直接参与注意力条件化、KV-cache 写入、MLP 计算与解码，从而在参数量不变时扩充可用的计算状态数。在 20B FineWeb-Edu token 上训练的 406M 参数模型将验证困惑度由 15.41 降至 14.40；与 hyper-connections、输入残差组合后进一步降至 13.61。在 Gated DeltaNet、Mamba-2、Triadic GDN 及 GDN-Mamba-2 混合架构上，各原生状态规模下均有改善，Lattice-GDN 变体甚至超过原生状态大 4 倍的基线。该结果表明常驻的逐层状态是扩展语言模型计算的一条独立且可组合的维度。
arxiv.reason: 新架构轴：逐层持久潜在状态，跨架构通用，结果扎实

arxiv.title: Turing Agent: Agentic Formal Verification for Mathematical Research
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly advancing mathematical discovery, moving beyond benchmark-level problem solving to tackle frontier research problems. This progress is ushering mathematics into an era of proof abundance, raising a fundamental challenge: how can we ensure the correctness of the ever-growing volume of AI-generated proofs and transform them into trustworthy, machine-verified mathematical knowledge? We introduce Turing Agent, an agent harness designed to orchestrate end-to-end formal verification of research-level mathematics. Its wo-scale architecture integrates theorem formalization and proof formalization agents, empowered by structured proof decomposition, parallel verification, accumulated proof experience, and selective semantic review. Leveraging our collaborations with theoretical computer science (TCS) researchers, we focus our evaluation on TCS, a particularly demanding domain characterized by intricate quantification, complex dependencies, and stringent semantic requirements. Against direct generation and general-purpose coding harnesses, including Codex CLI and Claude Code, Turing Agent achieves approximately 57-62% faithful formalization success on Formal TCS Bench and 83% overall pass@1 on a TCS-focused subset of RLMEval, using GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro. Notably, Turing Agent, built on DeepSeek, successfully completes the formal verification of three previously unresolved TCS tasks from OpenAI's October 2026 collection. One particularly challenging TCS problem required about a hundred formally verified auxiliary claims. Moreover, by actively exploring and refining the formalization process, Turing Agent can uncover simpler alternative proofs, expose unnecessary dependencies in original proofs, and generate reusable mathematical knowledge as a byproduct of verification.
arxiv.titleZh: Turing Agent：面向数学研究的智能体式形式化验证
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 AI 生成证明数量激增但正确性难以保证的问题，构建端到端形式化验证的 agent harness。双尺度架构由定理形式化与证明形式化 agent 组成，配合结构化证明分解、并行验证、累积证明经验与选择性语义审查。在理论计算机科学（TCS）任务上，对 Formal TCS Bench 取得约 57–62% 的忠实形式化成功率，在 RLMEval 的 TCS 子集上 pass@1 达 83%，并基于 DeepSeek 完成 OpenAI 2026 年 10 月合集中三个此前未解决的 TCS 任务，其中一个需约百条形式化辅助命题。该流程还能暴露原证明中的冗余依赖、发现更简证明，并把验证副产品沉淀为可复用的数学知识。
arxiv.reason: Agent 与形式化验证结合做数学科研自动化，直接命中 Agent 与 AI for Research 方向

arxiv.title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
arxiv.abstract: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification. Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope through proxy feedback. RepoFactory produces 10,159 environments across 17 software domains. Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, which achieves gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five benchmarks covering long-horizon coding and agentic tasks in real-world production settings, compared with 17.5 and 6.4 points without environment evolution. These results highlight the training value of RepoFactory environments and the additional gains from the Environment Evolution Loop.
arxiv.titleZh: 从仓库到训练环境:用环境进化循环扩展长程编码智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 长程编码智能体的训练依赖可验证反馈的环境，而现有流水线多为线性流程、止于验证，难以指导训练价值的提升。RepoFactory 自动把真实代码仓库转换为可验证环境，要求智能体依据语言规格从零构建完整项目，并通过环境进化循环以有效性、结构耦合度和实现范围构成的乘性目标做代理反馈优化。该流水线覆盖 17 个软件领域，产出 10,159 个环境;在其上训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 得到 RepoHorizen-35B-A3B，在 NL2Repo-Bench 上提升 22.6 个百分点，在五个长程编码与智能体基准上平均提升 8.5 个百分点，而未启用环境进化时分别为 17.5 和 6.4。
arxiv.reason: 长程编码智能体训练环境合成，直接命中 Agent 与代码智能方向

arxiv.title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
arxiv.abstract: We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurements. Modality-specific projectors map these representations into the input space of a shared backbone, which processes them alongside text and images. To develop the model's agent capabilities, we construct verifiable environments for tool use, search, and coding, as well as specialized workflows involving machine learning experiments and scientific software. Task completion is checked against execution results, changes in environment state, or submitted artifacts. We evaluate Sage S1.5 Flash on 33 benchmarks across seven domains. In the primary comparison against five baselines, it ranks first on OfficeQA Pro (72.2), MLE-bench Lite (90.3 HumanRank), Harvey LAB, and SpreadsheetBench~2, and second on OSWorld-Verified (85.2), WebArena-Verified (67.6), and DeepResearch Bench~II (54.2). These results show particular strengths in using documentary evidence, producing verifiable workbooks, and carrying out machine learning tasks, alongside competitive performance in desktop and browser workflows that require the model to act on visual feedback.
arxiv.titleZh: Sage S2.1 Flash 技术报告
arxiv.summaryZh: 320B 参数通用 MoE 模型：专用编码器处理分子图、生物序列与光谱（按有序测量 patch 表示），经模态投影器接入共享主干，与文本、图像联合处理；为构建 agent 能力，搭建工具调用、搜索、代码及 ML 实验、科学软件的可验证环境，以执行结果或环境状态变化判定完成。在 7 领域 33 个基准上，OfficeQA Pro（72.2）、MLE-bench Lite（90.3 HumanRank）、Harvey LAB 与 SpreadsheetBench 2 排第一，OSWorld-Verified（85.2）、WebArena-Verified（67.6）、DeepResearch Bench II（54.2）排第二。优势集中在文档证据使用、可验证表格产出与机器学习任务，桌面与浏览器视觉反馈工作流亦具竞争力。
arxiv.reason: 旗舰级 MoE 模型技术报告，覆盖 Agent 环境与多模态，分量足

arxiv.title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
arxiv.abstract: Recent self-improving coding agents have achieved strong benchmark performance by iteratively modifying their own executable implementations. A common pattern uses downstream task-derived evidence to decide which candidates or lineages continue evolving, which we term evaluate-and-select. Obtaining this signal requires repeatedly executing evolved agents on downstream tasks, so broader exploration incurs increasing evaluation cost, while repeated optimization against a fixed evaluation distribution may encourage benchmark-specific adaptation. We ask: can coding agents self-improve without downstream task evaluation inside the evolution loop? We introduce Explore-then-Integrate (ELITE), which integrates implementation mechanisms rather than selecting a single exploratory child to continue the lineage. At each generation, ELITE proposes diverse focused improvements, implements them independently from the same parent, and inspects the resulting programs to identify complementary, redundant, and conflicting mechanisms before reimplementing a compatible subset as one coherent descendant. No downstream task outcomes or task-solving trajectories of evolved candidates are used to guide evolution; only deterministic checks of structural and operational validity are used inside the loop. On SWE-bench Pro, ELITE improves the initial agent from 60.0% to 85.6%, compared with 86.7% for the Darwin Godel Machine (DGM) and 88.3% for the Huxley-Godel Machine (HGM), while using zero candidate task evaluations and reducing observed wall-clock evolution time by 8.8x and 3.2x, respectively, under the evaluated configurations. In cross-benchmark transfer without further adaptation, ELITE averages 73.3% on SWE-bench Verified and 69.3% on Polyglot. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of coding-agent self-improvement without downstream candidate task evaluation in our setting.
arxiv.titleZh: 无需评估的编码智能体递归自我改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 编码智能体的自我进化通常依赖「评估—选择」：反复在下游任务上执行候选实现来决定哪一支继续演化，评估成本随探索范围增长，且长期对固定评测分布优化易造成基准特化。Explore-then-Integrate（ELITE）改为整合机制而非挑选单个子代：每代从同一父代独立实现多个聚焦改进，检视所得程序以识别互补、冗余与冲突的机制，再把兼容子集重新实现为一个连贯后代，循环内只用结构与运行有效性的确定性检查。在 SWE-bench Pro 上把初始智能体从 60.0% 提升到 85.6%，接近 DGM 的 86.7% 与 HGM 的 88.3%，但零候选任务评估，实测演化耗时分别缩短 8.8 倍与 3.2 倍；不做额外适配的跨基准迁移在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Polyglot 上平均为 73.3% 与 69.3%。
arxiv.reason: 编码智能体自我进化且去除下游评估，直击 Agent 与自进化方向

arxiv.title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
arxiv.abstract: We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. The models lead or are competitive with strong open models of their size on agentic and coding benchmarks. On the modeling side, to strengthen reasoning, we introduce Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoVA), applying MoE to attention value projections, and softplus attention gating, a more flexible, theoretically motivated gate. Our 36B-A4B model uses both and nearly matches a 32B dense model trained on the same data, with one-seventh the active parameters. We also introduce Uno, lossless diffusion adapters that speed up decoding by up to 2.2x without a separate draft model. Our release follows the LLM360 definition of open source for transparency and reproducibility: the full development history, including intermediate checkpoints from every training stage, pre-training data, training logs, and all training, evaluation, and infrastructure code, notably our production-scale xLLM framework for dense and MoE training and the RL360 reinforcement-learning stack. Beyond the data itself, we release and document in detail every pipeline that built it, the part of model development that open releases most rarely disclose. These pipelines produced roughly 10T synthetic pre-training tokens, showing that synthetic data can be a major ingredient of pre-training at scale. Four of the models share one 22T-token pre-training corpus and recipe, revealing consistent scaling behavior and enabling controlled studies of scale and sparsity. All artifacts are available at https://ifm.ai/k2/
arxiv.titleZh: K2-Horizon:一支前沿的开源语言模型舰队
arxiv.summaryZh: 开源六款语言模型(0.9B 稠密至 375B-A23B MoE)，面向数学与科学推理、软件工程、深度研究、办公自动化等推理与 Agent 任务，在同规模开源模型中于 Agent 与代码基准上领先或持平。建模上提出 Mixture-of-Value Attention(MoVA，把 MoE 用于注意力 value 投影)与 softplus 注意力门控，36B-A4B 模型仅用约七分之一激活参数即接近同数据训练的 32B 稠密模型;Uno 无损扩散适配器无需独立草稿模型即可把解码提速至多 2.2 倍。发布遵循 LLM360 开源定义，公开全部中间 checkpoint、预训练数据、日志及 xLLM 训练框架与 RL360 强化学习栈，并以约 10T 合成预训练 token 说明合成数据可成为大规模预训练的主要成分。
arxiv.reason: 旗舰级开源模型技术报告，MoE 注意力新架构与 Agent/RL 栈均命中高分方向

arxiv.title: GPRM: Global Perspective Process Reward Model
arxiv.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) are widely used for step-level evaluation of multi-step reasoning in large language models, but existing methods are often limited by weak historical dependency modeling and insufficient global awareness. They typically fail to leverage prior step evaluations for coherent judgment and lack visibility into subsequent reasoning, leading to suboptimal assessment of intermediate steps. To address this issue, we propose the Global Perspective Process Reward Model (GPRM), which jointly models the problem, previous reasoning steps and their evaluations, the current step, and future steps to enable history-aware and globally informed process evaluation. We further introduce a structured evaluation framework along four dimensions---look back, look ahead, self-check, and goal alignment---to assess prior consistency, future plausibility, step validity, and task alignment. Based on this framework, we construct datasets for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO). Experiments show that, despite using less training data and smaller model sizes, GPRM outperforms strong baseline models by 7.8 and 5.4 points on PRMBench and ProcessBench, respectively. GPRM also generalizes well across tasks, surpassing the GPT-4.1 baseline on Agent Error Bench, improving strong baselines by around 4 points under test-time scaling (TTS), and achieving competitive performance on PPE.
arxiv.titleZh: GPRM：全局视角过程奖励模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有过程奖励模型（PRM）在逐步评估多步推理时历史依赖建模弱、缺乏全局视野，难以借助前序步骤的评估做连贯判断，也看不到后续推理。GPRM 将问题、先前推理步骤及其评估、当前步骤与未来步骤联合建模，实现历史感知与全局知情的过程评估，并沿回顾、前瞻、自检、目标对齐四个维度构建结构化评估框架及 SFT 与 GRPO 数据集。在训练数据更少、模型更小的情况下，GPRM 于 PRMBench 与 ProcessBench 分别超出强基线 7.8 与 5.4 分，并在 Agent Error Bench 上超过 GPT-4.1、在 test-time scaling 下较强基线提升约 4 分，可推广到多任务过程监督与推理时扩展场景。
arxiv.reason: PRM 全局建模与 GRPO 后训练，直接命中过程奖励方向

arxiv.title: LEAF-OPD: Learning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation
arxiv.abstract: LLM unlearning aims to erase targeted knowledge from large language models while preserving their utility. However, many existing methods suppress target knowledge without explicitly teaching the model how to respond to queries about it. We propose LEAF-OPD (LEArning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation), in which a frozen teacher provides token-level supervision on student-generated responses. On forget data, the teacher uses privileged contexts (instructions not to reveal knowledge about forget targets) to guide forgetting. On retain data, the teacher provides supervision without privileged context to preserve model utility. The student operates without privileged context in both cases, learning how to respond when encountering knowledge that should be forgotten. A key challenge is that the teacher often provides effective supervision only at the first few tokens of student trajectories. We introduce Supervision Signal (SS) to measure corrective supervision over a specified token interval, evaluating the entire trajectory (SS1) and its second half (SS0.5) to assess overall strength and late-stage persistence. When supervision is weak, lightweight SFT strengthens the teacher's context-conditioned refusal behavior, substantially increasing both scores. We evaluate LEAF-OPD on three widely used benchmarks: TOFU, RWKU, and MUSE-News. On TOFU, LEAF-OPD achieves the best Forget Quality, Model Utility, and Forget ROUGE-L while maintaining competitive retain performance. On RWKU, it outperforms the second-best method by 34% in Forget Quality while maintaining competitive Retain Quality. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of privileged-context supervision with on-policy token-level distillation for LLM unlearning.
arxiv.titleZh: LEAF-OPD：通过在线策略蒸馏从特权上下文学习遗忘
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对LLM遗忘方法只压制目标知识、却不教会模型如何回应相关提问的问题，提出LEAF-OPD：冻结教师对学生自生成回答做token级监督，在遗忘数据上借助特权上下文（禁止泄露遗忘目标的指令）引导遗忘，在保留数据上不加特权上下文以维持通用能力，学生始终在无特权上下文下学习正确应答。为刻画教师监督常只在前几个token有效的问题，引入监督信号SS（SS1评估全程、SS0.5评估后半程）。在TOFU上遗忘质量、模型效用与Forget ROUGE-L均为最佳，在RWKU上遗忘质量较次优方法提升34%且保留质量相当。
arxiv.reason: 在线策略蒸馏用于LLM遗忘，方法新颖且三benchmark验证

arxiv.title: ParGLU: Partial Gating Improves Language Modeling in MoE Transformers
arxiv.abstract: Multiplicative gating improves Transformer feed-forward networks (FFNs), but it reduces intermediate representation width under a fixed parameter budget. This trade-off is particularly relevant to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where individual experts have limited capacity. We introduce ParGLU, a partially gated FFN that combines SwiGLU and ReLU$^2$ in two parallel branches. ParGLU matches the parameter count and principal matrix computation budget of conventional SwiGLU. We evaluate ParGLU in 30M, 75M, and 152M MoE language models using three random seeds per scale. ParGLU outperforms SwiGLU across all three seeds at 75M and 152M, reducing mean validation NLL by 0.0200 and 0.0249, respectively. Results at 30M are mixed. Controlled ablations show that increasing backbone width or expert width strengthens ParGLU's relative performance. Ablation studies further show that combining SwiGLU and ReLU$^2$ improves performance over either architecture alone. Token-frequency analysis reveals larger improvements on low-frequency tokens. These findings show that fully gated FFNs are not always the most effective use of an MoE expert's parameter budget. Partial gating can improve language modeling in MoE Transformers.
arxiv.titleZh: ParGLU：部分门控改进 MoE Transformer 的语言建模
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 MoE 专家容量有限时全门控 FFN 压缩中间表示宽度的问题，提出 ParGLU：将 SwiGLU 与 ReLU² 两条并行分支组合成部分门控 FFN，参数量与主要矩阵计算量与 SwiGLU 持平。在 30M、75M、152M 三档 MoE 语言模型上各跑三个随机种子，75M 与 152M 全部种子均优于 SwiGLU，平均验证 NLL 分别降低 0.0200 与 0.0249，30M 结果混合。消融显示加宽主干或专家宽度会放大 ParGLU 优势，且改进主要来自低频 token，说明全门控并非 MoE 专家参数预算的最优用法。
arxiv.reason: MoE 与 FFN 门控架构改进，直接命中 LLM 架构方向
