arxiv.title: SWE-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Coding
arxiv.abstract: In this work, we study on-policy distillation (OPD) for transferring agentic coding capabilities from a large teacher model to a smaller student model. Prior work has focused primarily on reasoning and short-horizon agentic tasks. We present SWE-OPD, a minimal OPD study for software engineering, where the student interacts with executable repositories and the teacher supervises the prefixes visited by the student. Across three teacher--student pairs, two training sources, and three SWE benchmarks, we find that on-policy supervision transfers coding capability: supervision from Qwen3.6-27B increases the SWE-bench Pro resolve rate of Qwen3.5-9B from 35.9% to 39.4%. Refreshing trajectories is not strictly required either, as an offline variant with cached teacher scores still improves over the student baselines while cutting end-to-end GPU-hours by 59.4%--72.6% and halving peak GPU allocation, at benchmark-dependent accuracy. Furthermore, we extend the offline variant to corss-tokenizer scenarios: distilling GLM-4.5-Air from DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 raises its SWE-bench Pro and Multilingual resolve rate from 35.8% to 39.7% and from 41.8% to 46.2%, around 4% and 4.6% improvement, respectively. We also find that a decreasing loss, however, does not necessarily indicate improved agent performance: under top-$K$ reverse-KL loss, one student exhibits severe repetition despite a decreasing loss. We identify a support-mass gradient term as a potential mechanism underlying this failure.
arxiv.titleZh: SWE-OPD：面向智能体编程的在线策略蒸馏
arxiv.summaryZh: 把大教师模型的软件工程智能体能力蒸馏进小模型：学生在可执行仓库中自主交互，教师只对学生实际访问到的前缀做逐 token 监督。三组教师—学生、两个训练来源、三个SWE benchmark上，Qwen3.6-27B监督使Qwen3.5-9B的SWE-bench Pro解决率从35.9%升至39.4%；用缓存教师分数的离线变体仍优于基线，同时省下59.4%–72.6%端到端GPU小时、峰值显存减半，并扩展到跨tokenizer场景（GLM-4.5-Air从DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731蒸馏后，SWE-bench Pro 35.8%→39.7%、Multilingual 41.8%→46.2%）。此外发现loss下降并不代表智能体性能变好：top-K reverse-KL下某学生出现严重重复生成，作者将成因指向support-mass梯度项。
arxiv.reason: 在线策略蒸馏+代码智能体，直接命中后训练与Agent方向

arxiv.title: SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents
arxiv.abstract: We introduce SciResearch-Eval, an interactive benchmark of scientific judgment built on a standard laboratory problem: measuring a material's thermal properties by heating it and fitting a heat-conduction simulator. An agent designs its own experiments, uses a supplied simulator that may be under-resolved or physically wrong, and reports each property with a 95% interval. To our knowledge it is the first benchmark to combine agent-designed experiments, a deliberately flawed simulator, and proper scoring of calibrated intervals against exact ground truth. On a held-out split (93 tasks, 9 models, 2,511 episodes), models handle procedural traps. When the simulator is missing physics, most report wrong values while stating they are 95% sure: their ranges contain the truth in 20-62% of cases, against 94% for GPT-6 Astra and 99% for Claude Fable 5.2. At default effort the failing Claude 5.5 models rarely diagnose the missing physics (Opus in 35% of episodes, against 66% for Astra), and even when they do, their ranges often miss; Astra and Fable design experiments in which the flawed simulator is accurate, such as gentle heating, which keeps Astra calibrated even when it does not name the cause. Asking for wider intervals does not help; stating the strategy improves interval scores 1.6-2.5-fold, replicated on a pre-registered fresh split, but coverage barely moves. A pre-registered effort ablation shows that the correction is latent in the Claude 5.5 models: at maximum effort Opus improves more than tenfold and is no longer detectably behind Astra at default, but only with 13-31 times more reasoning; older and open-weight models gain nothing. Fable 5.2 is the most accurate model at default effort (interval score 1.9 times better than Astra's) but writes 6 times as many tokens, and at Astra's token count it falls short. We release the environment, graders and harness.
arxiv.titleZh: SciResearch-Eval:评估自主实验智能体的科学判断力
arxiv.summaryZh: 提出交互式基准 SciResearch-Eval:智能体自行设计加热实验，调用可能分辨率不足或物理错误的导热模拟器，并对材料属性给出 95% 区间，按校准区间评分与精确真值比对。在 93 个任务、9 个模型、2511 个回合的留出集上，模型能避开流程性陷阱，但模拟器缺失物理时区间覆盖率仅 20–62%(GPT-6 Astra 94%、Claude Fable 5.2 99%)，且多数未诊断出原因;显式说明策略使区间分数提升 1.6–2.5 倍而覆盖率几乎不变，最大努力下 Opus 提升逾十倍但推理量增 13–31 倍。
arxiv.reason: Agent 科研基准，含校准区间评分与预注册消融，契合 AI for Research 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked: Reward Hacking Under an Exact Process Oracle
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards inherits whatever its verifier gets wrong. Outside mathematics and code the verifier is a proxy, a rubric, a learned judge or a hand-written checker, and its distance from the true objective is never measured, so a rising reward cannot be told apart from a hack. We build a setting where the true reward is exactly computable at the process level: executable authorization policies over 124,416 contexts admit an oracle that lists every minimal sufficient reason for every decision. We compile these policies into exact process rewards, degrade the verifier along seven realistic axes (outcome-only, sufficiency, recall-only, extraction noise, coarse taxonomy, stale policy, LLM judge), and train against each while the exact verifier scores every rollout. Four phenotypes appear. Optimistic verifiers are hacked by padding: the sufficiency proxy ends at 0.940 while true faithfulness falls from 0.731 to 0.667 on 96 held-out episodes. Outcome-only verifiers saturate and stop teaching, noise dilutes, and ranking-preserving gaps do no harm. A model-free audit of the verifier, its selection error and gap sign, together with a short saturation pilot, anticipates which phenotype a run will produce. Across nine configurations spanning two frameworks, two model vendors, two adapter sizes, three precisions, two initialisations and two seeds, the phenotypes recur, sufficiency damage is positive in all 10 replication cells and beyond two standard errors in 7, and optimistic gaps remain the steeper branch. The damage magnitude does not replicate, and five pre-registered attempts to explain it are reported as they fell. We release the testbed, the training instrumentation, and 14 real public policies (Cedar, OPA, Gatekeeper) ported to executable oracles.
arxiv.comment: 30 pages. A shorter version, "The Verifier Gap", appears at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Meta-Agents (non-archival)
arxiv.titleZh: 乐观验证器被攻破：精确过程 oracle 下的奖励黑客
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对RLVR在数学与代码之外依赖代理验证器、奖励上升难辨真实进步与奖励黑客的问题，用可执行授权策略构建过程级真值可精确计算的测试台（124,416个上下文），并把策略编译为精确过程奖励。沿仅结果、充分性、仅召回、抽取噪声、粗粒度分类、过期策略、LLM judge七个维度退化验证器后训练，精确验证器逐条评分：乐观验证器靠填充被黑，充分性代理达0.940而96个留出回合的真实忠实度从0.731降至0.667；仅结果验证器饱和，噪声稀释，保序差距无害。验证器的无模型审计加短饱和试点可预判表型，九种配置下充分性损伤10/10复现单元为正、7个超过两倍标准误。

arxiv.title: AuXSpec: Learning to Autoformalize Program Specifications via Executable Postconditions
arxiv.abstract: Formal specifications define intended program behavior and underpin verification, but writing them in theorem provers such as Lean is slow and expertise-intensive, making specification a major bottleneck to scaling formally correct code. Autoformalization from natural-language problems is promising, yet training specification models requires scalable feedback on whether generated specifications capture intended behavior. Prior approaches obtain this feedback through explicit proofs or separately implemented code with formal correspondence proofs, both expensive. We introduce AuXSpec, a Lean framework that pairs declarative postconditions with executable counterparts, obtained through type class resolution when possible and otherwise defined separately with an equivalence proof. Test cases can then evaluate declarative specifications by execution, letting us use agreement as a reinforcement-learning reward. Using AuXSpec, we synthesize 3,037 LeetCode problems and expand training to 19.5K samples through expert iteration on Codeforces. Experiments show that training Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with the execution-based reward improves SpecGen pass@4 on AuXSpec-Test 0.7% $\to$ 82.7% and 14.3% $\to$ 84.3%, and the 27B model outperforms all frontier models. On the out-of-domain Verina benchmark with its original prompts, both models improve 7.0% $\to$ 90.5% and 21.9% $\to$ 90.5% and surpass VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B, the prior state of the art among open-source specification models, on pass@1 (theirs 47.6% vs. ours 73.7% and 84.5%) and pass@4 (theirs 63.9% at pass@10 vs. ours 90.5%). We release the weights of the trained 9B and 27B models and the 3,037 problems with test cases, including the 300-problem AuXSpec-Test benchmark with expert review and correctness proofs for future evaluation. Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec. Website: https://auxspec.org
arxiv.titleZh: AuXSpec:通过可执行后置条件学习程序规约的自动形式化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Lean 中手写形式规约慢且依赖专家、自动形式化又缺少可扩展反馈信号的问题，把声明式后置条件与可执行实现配对:能通过类型类解析自动获得可执行版本，否则另行实现并给出等价性证明，从而用测试用例执行规约，并以执行结果与预期行为的一致性作为强化学习奖励。基于 3,037 道 LeetCode 题合成数据，并通过 Codeforces 上的专家迭代把训练规模扩到 19.5K 样本;训练 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Qwen3.8-27B 后，AuXSpec-Test 上 pass@4 分别从 0.7% 提升到 82.7%、从 14.3% 提升到 84.3%，在域外 Verina 基准上 pass@1 达 73.7% / 84.5%，超过 VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B 的 47.6%。该工作给出可执行奖励驱动的规约生成训练闭环，并开源权重、题目与含专家评审和正确性证明的 300 题测试集。
arxiv.reason: Lean 规约自动形式化 + 可执行奖励 RL，命中代码智能与 RLVR

arxiv.title: Harness Leverage Across Model Size: A Ladder of Five Local Agent Harnesses from 0.75B to 4.7B
arxiv.abstract: A harness turns a model into a system that completes tasks: it builds the prompt, exposes tools and decides when work is done. Harness comparisons hold the model fixed. Model comparisons hold the harness fixed. We vary both: five shipped harnesses, 18 artifact-producing tasks, four locally deployable open-weight models from 0.75B to 4.7B and a 35.5B anchor, with one deterministic checker scoring all 360 ladder cells. The completion-controlling harness, Mingbird, has the highest mean at every size. Of four pre-registered paired contrasts, two survive Holm correction, at 0.75B and 4.7B. Thirteen of sixteen paired intervals exclude zero under the deployment reading, with leads from 0.075 over the strongest rival to 0.819 over the weakest. The completion gate is not the carrier: disabling all six executable checks moves the mean by +0.080, +0.117, +0.003 and -0.004, every interval including zero, and only at 1.9B does disabling it create empty runs. Removing one repeat-blocking rule alone costs 0.411 at 0.75B and leaves eight of eighteen tasks with no artifact. The harness effect is a progress effect: it decides whether a run leaves anything on disk. Of 357 usable cells, 127 leave none of their declared artifacts and 85 of those exit normally, so a scorer that reads exit status credits work that was never written. Whether the effect grows or shrinks with size, four rungs cannot settle: a floor arm produces a rise, a ceiling a decline, and a cross-family rung a peak.
arxiv.titleZh: 跨越模型规模的 Harness 杠杆效应：从 0.75B 到 4.7B 的五个本地 Agent Harness 阶梯
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 Harness 对比固定模型、模型对比固定 Harness，而该工作让两者同时变化：五个已发布的 Harness、18 个需要产出产物的任务、四个 0.75B–4.7B 本地可部署开源模型外加一个 35.5B 锚点模型，共 360 个阶梯单元由同一个确定性检查器打分。控制完成判定的 Harness Mingbird 在每个规模上均值最高；四个预注册配对对比中两个通过 Holm 校正（0.75B 与 4.7B），在部署读法下 16 个配对区间有 13 个排除零，领先幅度从 0.075 到 0.819。关闭全部六个可执行检查只让均值变动 +0.080、+0.117、+0.003、-0.004；而单独去掉一条阻止重复的规则，在 0.75B 上就损失 0.411，并使 18 个任务中有 8 个没有产物。核心结论是 Harness 效应实为「进度效应」，即决定一次运行是否在磁盘上留下东西：357 个可用单元中有 127 个未留下任何声明产物，其中 85 个正常退出，因此按退出状态打分的高估了实际完成的工作。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness 与 scaffold 的系统性对比，兼有评测方法学洞见

arxiv.title: Benchleaking Is Accelerating: Benchmark contamination has worsened sharply in the past month -- from post-training down to pre-training base models
arxiv.abstract: Benchmark contamination is not new, but recent model releases show it in a sharper form. We use the term benchleaking for the case in which a benchmark's own test examples enter training data, so that a score reflects recall rather than capability. This differs from benchmaxxing, which optimizes toward a benchmark without seeing its test set. We document two escalations over the past month. First, in post-training, the traces have become explicit: recent audits show an agent stating hidden test requirements it was never given in 23% of its attempts, where its predecessor did so in none, and continuing to follow them after the task is changed to contradict them (Schaeffer and Räuker, 2026; Lo and Lo, 2026). Second, the problem has reached pre-training. Using few-shot continuation on 20 benchmarks across four public base models, we find that some base models write out other test examples---complete questions, options, and answers---that appear nowhere in their input. For the recently released ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base, 96% of HumanEval problems leak with their reference implementations and 85% of OpenBookQA questions leak with their answers, against 9% and none for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base. To quantify what a reported score owes to such examples, we define an Anti-Hack score: the benchmark score recomputed with every leaked example marked wrong and the number of examples unchanged. Averaged over the suite, it costs DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base 1.5 points and Hy3-preview-Base 1.3, against 5.0 for MiMo-V2.5-Base and 16.6 for ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base. Open base models are the foundation of much downstream research, so benchleaking now affects more than leaderboard rankings. We call for decontamination reports and contamination-adjusted scores to become standard practice.
arxiv.titleZh: Benchleaking 正在加速：基准污染在过去一个月急剧恶化——从后训练一路蔓延到预训练基座模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 区分「benchleaking」（测试样例进入训练数据，分数反映记忆而非能力）与「benchmaxxing」，并记录一个月内的两级升级：后训练中智能体在23%的尝试里说出从未被给予的隐藏测试要求，且在任务被改为与之矛盾后仍照做；预训练层面用少样本续写探测4个基座模型在20个基准上的表现，部分模型会写出输入中不存在的完整题目与答案，ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base 在 HumanEval 上96%的题目连同参考实现泄露、OpenBookQA 85%连带答案，DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base 仅9%与0。据此提出 Anti-Hack 分数：泄露样例一律判错、样本数不变后重算，套件平均使 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base 损失1.5分、Hy3-preview-Base 1.3分，MiMo-V2.5-Base 为5.0分、ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base 达16.6分。污染已波及基座模型与下游研究，需把去污染报告与污染校正分数变成常规实践。
arxiv.reason: 基准污染审计，直击评估可靠性，并给出新指标

arxiv.title: Latent Bridge: Asking for Help Without Words
arxiv.abstract: Text-based model collaboration requires a large model to generate intermediate responses before a smaller model can use its guidance, adding large-model decoding cost to inference. We introduce POND (Prefill-Only, No-Decode), a method that uses a frozen large sender for prefill and a small receiver for all autoregressive decoding. A trainable bridge maps the sender's hidden states to additional attention keys and values, allowing the receiver to use these representations throughout generation. POND also supports periodic review, in which the sender processes the receiver's partial response and updates its guidance through additional prefill passes while preserving the receiver's existing KV cache. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, POND improves receiver performance with senders from different model families. In particular, GLM-5.3 provides gains comparable to those of Qwen3.8-Max when paired with a Qwen receiver, supporting the effectiveness of representation transfer between independently trained model families. POND further demonstrates its ability to generalize across domains. When trained on math and coding tasks, it transfers directly to general knowledge tasks without additional domain-specific training. These results demonstrate that large frontier model prefill representations can improve small-model generation without requiring large-model autoregressive decoding.
arxiv.titleZh: Latent Bridge:不靠文字来求助
arxiv.summaryZh: 文本式模型协作要求大模型先生成中间回复，小模型才能借用其指导，推理时因此多出大模型解码开销。POND 让冻结的大模型只做 prefill，全部自回归解码交给小模型：可训练的 bridge 把 sender 隐状态映射为额外的 attention key/value，供小模型全程调用；周期性 review 让大模型处理小模型的部分回复，并在保留其 KV cache 的前提下用额外 prefill 更新指导。在推理与代码基准上，该方法对不同模型家族的 sender 均带来提升，GLM-5.3 与 Qwen3.8-Max 作 sender 时增益相当，且仅在数学与代码上训练即可零样本迁移到通用知识任务。这说明大模型的 prefill 表示足以改进小模型生成，无需大模型解码。
arxiv.reason: 大模型仅用 prefill 表示辅助小模型生成，跨模型家族可迁移，方法扎实

arxiv.title: The Price of Choosing Examples: Context Overfitting in Adaptive In-Context Learning
arxiv.abstract: In-context learning is usually analyzed as if the examples in the prompt were sampled before the learner is chosen. In deployed systems they are not: examples are retrieved, filtered, re-ranked, edited, and repeatedly tested after seeing the query and the data store. We formalize this gap by treating prompt construction as adaptive data analysis through a conditional stochastic-kernel calculus. Our main quantity is the context capacity, the mutual information or approximate max-information between the data store and the final prompt transcript. For any frozen in-context learner and any adaptive context pipeline with capacity $κ$, we prove a finite-sample context generalization bound of order $\sqrt{κ/k}$, where $k$ is the number of selected examples whose losses form the reported score. We prove a matching lower bound, whose constant is exact when $\log k\llκ\ll k$, and derive two PAC-Bayesian retrieval rules: a first-order Gibbs rule that charges data-dependent candidate gates their prior mass, and a self-normalized second-order rule. On Banking77 with 64 retrieval recipes and two model families, the certificates hold in all 24,000 resampled selection events, and from 64 (Qwen2.5-7B) or 128 (GPT-4.1-mini) reused validation queries the Gibbs rule certifies a risk below the zero-shot error in over 99% of validation draws. Finally, we instantiate the theory for Bayesian linear in-context regression, including an order-statistics analysis of query-aligned top-$k$ Gaussian retrieval. The results separate context quality from context certification: longer or more relevant contexts improve risk only when the procedure used to choose them is stable enough for selected-context evidence to transfer.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Xiaoyu Li and Jiangxuan Long contributed equally. 31 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 选择样本的代价:自适应上下文学习中的上下文过拟合
arxiv.summaryZh: 部署系统中的提示示例往往是在看到查询与数据仓库后经检索、过滤、重排反复挑选的，而经典上下文学习分析假定示例先于学习器采样，二者的差距会导致选择偏差。论文把提示构建形式化为自适应数据分析，提出以数据仓库与最终提示记录之间的互信息(或近似最大信息)定义的"上下文容量"κ，对任意冻结的上下文学习器证明量级为√(κ/k)的有限样本泛化界，并给出匹配下界;据此导出两种PAC-Bayesian检索规则:对数据依赖的候选门按先验质量计费的一阶Gibbs规则与自归一化二阶规则。在Banking77上，64种检索方案、两个模型家族的24,000次重采样选择事件中证书全部成立，Gibbs规则在超过99%的验证抽样下认证风险低于零样本错误率。
arxiv.reason: 上下文学习选择偏差的理论刻画与PAC-Bayesian检索规则，命中后训练与评估方法学

arxiv.title: MiSTiQ: MicroScaling Trellis Quantization for Extreme KV Cache Compression
arxiv.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly support longer contexts and serve more concurrent requests, increasing both sequence lengths and batch sizes. Both trends increase KV-cache size and memory traffic during inference. KV-cache quantization reduces these costs, with recent approaches using codebook-based vector quantization to achieve extremely low bit widths. However, hardware constraints limit codebook size, and most methods reconstruct the cache in higher-precision floating-point formats for attention, limiting the computational benefits of quantization. To address these limitations, we introduce MiSTiQ, a drop-in replacement for codebook-based vector quantizers that combines trellis-coded storage with microscaling (MX) formats for low-precision computation. We combine trellis quantization with beam search to encode the KV cache over large reconstruction spaces without large codebooks. To support MX computation, we derive MX-Hash functions that generate reconstruction values directly in the target MX element format. These functions use the scale-conditioned marginal distribution of block-normalized Gaussian inputs. On Llama3 and Qwen3, MiSTiQ achieves lower WikiText perplexity and higher GSM8K accuracy than the evaluated baselines across several block-scale formats at approximately 1.25 effective bits per element. With NVFP4, it also achieves the highest LongBench average on both models.
arxiv.titleZh: MiSTiQ：用于极致 KV Cache 压缩的微缩放格量化
arxiv.summaryZh: KV cache 量化在极低位宽下常依赖码本向量量化，但码本大小受硬件限制，且注意力计算前多需把 cache 还原成高精度浮点，量化收益有限。MiSTiQ 以格编码（trellis-coded）存储替代码本，并用 beam search 在大重建空间中编码，同时推导出 MX-Hash 函数，直接在 MX 元素格式下生成重建值以支持低精度计算。在 Llama3 与 Qwen3 上，约 1.25 有效比特/元素时，其 WikiText 困惑度低于基线、GSM8K 准确率更高；采用 NVFP4 时两模型 LongBench 平均分均为最高。该工作面向长上下文与高并发推理的 KV cache 显存与带宽瓶颈，属于推理系统与量化的交叉方向。
arxiv.reason: KV cache 极低位宽量化新方法，直击高效推理方向

arxiv.title: SWE-WhatIf: Simulating Real Users of Coding Agents from Recorded Session
arxiv.abstract: Recorded sessions between users and coding agents offer a way to evaluate how agents complete real-world tasks and interact with users. However, these sessions cannot simply be replayed with new agents, because recorded user replies may no longer apply when an agent takes a different trajectory. We introduce SWE-WhatIf, which replays recorded sessions with new agents by modeling the user's intents, the criteria for satisfying them, and the conditions under which they arise. Using this model, a user simulator generates replies that adapt to unseen agent turns while remaining grounded in the recording. Across 89 real-world sessions, SWE-WhatIf generated the replies most similar to those of real users and matched the strongest baseline when sessions were rewritten. To test adaptation, we replay sessions with agents instructed to avoid or repeat actions that the recorded user pushed back on. SWE-WhatIf produced the highest win rate for avoiding these actions (66.3%), significantly above chance. We further demonstrate its utility by ranking five LLMs as coding agents, where the highest-ranked model depended on how users specified and developed their intents, and a study with 16 users, where replaying their own sessions changed 14 participants' rankings and informed their future agent use.
arxiv.titleZh: SWE-WhatIf：从录制的会话中模拟编程智能体的真实用户
arxiv.summaryZh: 录制的用户—编程智能体会话无法直接重放：新智能体一旦走不同轨迹，真实用户回复便不再适用。SWE-WhatIf 通过建模用户意图、意图满足的判定标准以及这些意图出现的条件，让用户模拟器生成既贴合原始录制、又能适应未见智能体行为的回复。在 89 个真实会话上，其生成的回复与真实用户最相似，改写会话后与最强基线持平；在要求智能体回避录制用户曾反对的动作时，回避成功率达 66.3%，显著高于随机水平。该工作可用于对编程智能体进行动态用户交互评测与模型排序。
arxiv.reason: 用用户模拟器重放真实编程会话，属Agent评测扎实工作

arxiv.title: MemDoctor: Stage-wise Error Attribution and Repair for MLLM Agent Memory
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now assist users across sessions of images and text, carried by an external memory of what was said and shown. When such an assistant answers wrongly, the failure usually began earlier, in how a record was written, updated or retrieved, and the answer alone does not say where. We formalize multimodal memory as four stages, Write, Update, Retrieve and Answer, and define nine error types across them. A stage-resolved analysis on Mem-Gallery traces most failures to a source stage, and most of those lie before the answer. Injecting known errors against fact-preserving control edits, we then follow each tainted record downstream. Early errors survive to the answer as apparent evidence, and hurt most when no other record holds the fact. A diagnosis that trusts the quoted evidence therefore blames the stage where the error surfaces, not the one where it began. We propose MemDoctor, in which the MLLM that built the memory diagnoses its own failures. It traces each needed fact backward through the four stages, accepts a diagnosis only when the cited evidence is found in memory, and repairs that stage before answering again. On a 4B backbone, MemDoctor improves accuracy on both Mem-Gallery and MemLens, outperforming all evaluated 8B baselines, and the same loop also improves MuRAG and A-Mem.
arxiv.titleZh: MemDoctor:面向 MLLM Agent 记忆的分阶段错误归因与修复
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态助手跨会话依赖外部记忆，答错时错误常源于更早的写入、更新或检索环节，答案本身并不指明位置。该工作把多模态记忆形式化为 Write、Update、Retrieve、Answer 四个阶段并定义九类错误，在 Mem-Gallery 上做阶段归因分析，并以错误注入追踪受污染记录的下游传播，发现早期错误会以“看似证据”的形式存活到答案。MemDoctor 让构建记忆的 MLLM 自诊断:沿四阶段回溯所需事实，只有引用证据在记忆中被找到才接受诊断，修复该阶段后重新作答;4B 骨干在 Mem-Gallery 与 MemLens 上超过所有评测的 8B 基线，同一循环也能提升 MuRAG 与 A-Mem。结果适用于多模态 Agent 记忆系统的可靠性诊断与修复。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆的分阶段归因与自修复，多模态，系统性较强

arxiv.title: Experience Rot: Experienced Agents Fail Where Novices Succeed
arxiv.abstract: Agents are increasingly built to learn from experience: they keep conversation histories, memory files, retrieved notes and skills, and reuse what worked before. We show that this experience turns against them when their tools change silently. We test a range of models with tools defined as in the Model Context Protocol (MCP). After a silent change, experienced agents fail on most tasks, while agents new to the task mostly succeed. We call this failure Experience Rot. Experienced agents copy their earlier call instead of checking the current interface, even when the tool definition shows the change. Then they report success. When the documentation is incomplete, experience is what makes agents succeed. After a change, the same experience leaves them worse off than no experience at all. The failure appears in every form of memory we test and grows with the amount of experience. Simple remedies fall short: announcing the update barely helps, and pointing the agent to the documentation fails whenever the documentation does not spell out the answer.
arxiv.titleZh: 经验腐化:有经验的 Agent 在新手能成功的场景下失败
arxiv.summaryZh: 工具接口静默变更后，依赖历史经验的 Agent 反而比零经验的新手更容易失败。研究以 MCP 定义工具，在多种模型上测试对话历史、记忆文件、检索笔记与技能等各类经验形式，发现经验丰富的 Agent 会直接复用旧的调用方式而不检查当前接口定义，即使定义中已显示变更，并在失败后仍报告成功;文档不完整时经验帮助最大，而一旦发生变更，同样的经验比没有经验更糟，且失败率随经验量增长。公布更新提示几乎无改善，在文档未写明答案时引导 Agent 查阅文档也无效。该结果对 Agent 记忆与经验复用机制的设计提出直接的可靠性警示。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工具调用与记忆复用失效的系统性实证研究，正击关注方向

arxiv.title: Accelerate Bench: Evaluating Agents for Application-Level Program Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Application optimization requires coding agents to discover useful changes and coordinate them across a complete program while preserving the required computation. We introduce Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions. Each task provides a working program and specifies the workload, correctness requirements, timing boundaries, and permitted edits, leaving agents to choose where and how to optimize. Public testing supports iterative development, and a separate verifier scores the final submission. On benchmark version 1.1, we evaluate 16 coding agents, each pairing a model with a harness. Their Score@1 ranges from 25.5% to 67.4%. Most of their programs are correct, and the size of the speedup separates them: the two leading agents are at least 2x faster on 22 or more of the 32 tasks, while the other fourteen reach 2x on 8 to 17 and leave 125 of their 412 correct outcomes below 1.25x. Controlled replays show why coordination across an application matters: identical source code runs between 0.29x and 2.12x depending only on build and runtime settings, and one code change is worth 1.01x or 6.4x depending on another. Accelerate Bench pairs executable workloads with agents' programs and trajectories to evaluate both their gains and the process behind them.
