arxiv.titleZh: Accelerate Bench：评估面向应用级程序优化的智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 应用级程序优化要求编程智能体在保持计算语义不变的前提下，找出有用的改动并在整个程序范围内协调这些改动。Accelerate Bench 构建了 32 个 CPU 优化任务，任务来自科学应用与超算竞赛;每个任务给出可运行程序，并规定工作负载、正确性要求、计时边界与允许的编辑范围，由智能体自行决定优化哪里、如何优化;公开测试支持迭代开发，独立验证器负责打分。评测 16 个由模型与 harness 组合而成的编程智能体，Score@1 介于 25.5% 与 67.4% 之间，多数提交程序正确，性能差距主要来自加速比:领先的两个智能体在 22 个以上任务上达到 2x 以上，其余 14 个仅在 8–17 个任务上达到 2x,412 个正确结果中有 125 个低于 1.25x。控制回放实验显示，同一份源码因构建与运行时设置不同可跑出 0.29x–2.12x，而一处改动的价值取决于另一处改动(1.01x 与 6.4x)，说明跨组件协调才是关键;该基准配套可执行负载与智能体轨迹，可同时评估性能收益与优化过程。
arxiv.reason: 编程智能体系统级优化基准，方法学扎实，命中代码智能与评测方向

arxiv.title: Instant Weight-Space Consolidation for Long-Term Memory in LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Agentic memory systems give LLMs persistent memory by extracting experience into text and retrieving it at query time, but the model itself does not evolve: however many interactions it has had, it starts each query the same. Extraction errors compound, implicit cross-session patterns that no single fragment states cannot be surfaced, and the construction cost grows with every conversation. Fine-tuning on past interactions does change the weights, but requires backpropagation at serving time and degrades on long histories. We introduce CLAM (Carried Latent Adapter Memory), which combines the strengths of both: a recurrent hypernetwork performs parametric consolidation, compiling a stream of session activations into a low-rank adapter in a single forward pass with no gradient steps and no language-model generation calls, while a complementary episodic buffer supplies verbatim detail at inference. A gated latent state carries knowledge across sessions in fixed size, so the parametric memory accumulates without growing. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across three open models (2-7B parameters), CLAM leads all agentic baselines by 1-45 points and all gradient-based parametric methods by 10-45 points, while requiring zero generative LLM calls, zero gradient steps, and 3-151x less wall-clock time than extraction systems to build its memory. The two channels are complementary: the consolidated adapter adds 12-15 accuracy points when the episodic buffer misses the gold evidence, and still adds 4-5 points even with an oracle buffer.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向 LLM 长期记忆的即时权重空间巩固
arxiv.summaryZh: Agentic 记忆系统把经验抽取成文本、在查询时检索，使 LLM 获得持久记忆，但模型权重本身并不演化:抽取误差逐层累积，跨会话的隐式模式无法浮现，构建成本随对话量线性增长。CLAM 将循环超网络与情景缓冲结合，前者在单次前向中把会话激活流编译为低秩 adapter，完成参数化巩固，无需梯度步也无需 LLM 生成调用;门控隐状态以固定大小跨会话传递知识，使参数化记忆不随交互增长;后者在推理时补充逐字细节。在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 上，三个 2–7B 开源模型中 CLAM 领先全部 agentic 基线 1–45 分、领先梯度型参数化方法 10–45 分，记忆构建的实际耗时降低 3–151 倍;情景缓冲漏掉金证据时 adapter 仍带来 12–15 分增益，oracle 缓冲下也有 4–5 分。
arxiv.reason: 权重空间参数化记忆巩固，免梯度即时适配，直击后训练与 Agent 记忆方向

arxiv.title: SpeCal: Spectral Calibration for Unsupervised RLVR
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the reasoning abilities of large language models, but its dependence on ground-truth answers or external verifiers limits its ability to exploit abundant unlabeled reasoning data. Unsupervised RLVR alleviates this bottleneck by deriving scalar rewards from the model's own rollouts. However, the reliability of such self-generated supervision varies substantially across rollout groups and individual responses, while existing methods construct or refine their rewards mainly from decoded outcomes and reward statistics. These endpoint signals reveal what answers the model produces, but provide limited information about whether the underlying rollout representations form a reliable structure for learning. Our key observation is that hidden-state spectra offer a complementary view of supervision reliability by characterizing both the organization of a rollout group and the support received by each rollout within that group. Based on this observation, we propose SpeCal, a bi-level spectral calibration framework for unsupervised RLVR. At the group level, SpeCal combines spectral mass with a Gaussian band-pass gate over normalized entropy-based effective rank, favoring rollout groups with substantial representation variation whose effective dimensionality lies in a preferred regime. At the rollout level, the same group effective rank determines how many dominant directions are retained in a leave-one-out spectral subspace formed by the remaining rollouts, within which the conditional support of each held-out rollout is measured. The resulting signals calibrate the original reward-induced advantages at the group and rollout levels without redefining the underlying unlabeled reward.
arxiv.titleZh: SpeCal：面向无监督 RLVR 的谱校准
arxiv.summaryZh: 无监督 RLVR 从模型自身 rollout 导出标量奖励，摆脱对标准答案与外部验证器的依赖，但自生成监督的可靠性在 rollout 组与单条样本之间差异很大；现有方法只看解码结果与奖励统计等结果层面的信号。SpeCal 改用隐藏状态谱判断监督是否可靠：在组级别，它把谱质量与基于归一化熵有效秩的高斯带通门结合起来，偏好表示变化充分且有效维度适中的 rollout 组；在样本级别，它用同一有效秩确定留一法谱子空间保留多少个主方向，并据此度量被留出的 rollout 从组内其余样本获得的条件支撑度。这些信号在组与样本两个层级上校准由奖励产生的优势，而不改写无标签奖励本身，适用于无标注推理数据的后训练。
arxiv.reason: 无监督 RLVR 的奖励可靠性校准，谱方法新颖，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Rethinking Supervision Scaling in On-Policy Distillation: From Dense Supervision to Stochastic Horizons
arxiv.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision along student-generated trajectories, yet the learning benefits of longer trajectories may not scale proportionally with their computational cost. We investigate how supervision utility evolves with trajectory length. Controlled experiments reveal diminishing returns from additional supervised tokens, while showing that later positions remain learnable and exhibit substantial cross-position supervision transfer. Gradient analysis further identifies shared update components across response positions and diverse position-specific residuals whose cross-rollout consistency decreases at greater depths. Motivated by these findings, we propose Stochastic Horizons On-Policy Distillation (SH-OPD), which reduces redundant supervision by randomly varying rollout horizons while preserving access to deeper response states. SH-OPD samples a shared horizon for each training batch, enabling efficient parallel generation without per-sequence horizon scheduling overhead. We characterize the resulting reweighting bias and derive a compute-reweighting trade-off under standard optimization assumptions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that SH-OPD achieves slightly higher mathematical reasoning accuracy at approximately 45% of the per-update cost of standard OPD, while maintaining competitive code generation performance at around 60% of the baseline cost. These results highlight the benefits of efficient supervision allocation across response depths.
arxiv.titleZh: 重新审视 On-Policy Distillation 的监督扩展：从稠密监督到随机视界
arxiv.summaryZh: On-Policy Distillation 沿学生轨迹提供稠密 token 级监督，但轨迹变长带来的收益并不随算力同比例增长。控制实验显示，新增监督 token 的边际收益递减；后段位置仍可学习，且存在显著的跨位置监督迁移；梯度分析进一步发现各位置共享的更新分量，以及随深度增大而跨 rollout 一致性下降的位置特异残差。据此提出的 SH-OPD 对每个 batch 采样统一 rollout horizon，在保留深层响应状态访问的同时削减冗余监督，并刻画了重加权偏差与算力与重加权之间的权衡。数学推理准确率略高于标准 OPD，单次更新成本约为其 45%，代码生成在约 60% 成本下保持竞争力。
arxiv.reason: on-policy 蒸馏的监督分配分析与改进，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: GEAR$^2$: Pruned Experts Live On through Gated Reuse of Activated Experts and a Missing-Mass Residual
arxiv.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs) activate only a few experts per token while generally keeping all the experts in GPU memory for high efficiency. Expert pruning reduces this GPU memory footprint cost, yet discards the contribution of pruned experts. Existing remedies either rely on static substitutes, merge experts at the cost of altering their functions, or require costly recovery training. In this paper, we find that the functionalities of pruned experts can be efficiently reconstructed from the activated remaining experts. We propose GEAR (Gated Expert Activation Reuse), which reuses the scaled outputs of reliable activated experts without any training or additional expert computation. In addition, we propose GEAR$^2$ to further recover what reuse cannot express with an ultra-lightweight residual. On five MoE LLMs from 16B to 106B parameters with 25% and 50% of experts pruned, GEAR improves over its training-free counterparts in nearly every setting (up to 4 pp.) in terms of accuracy, and GEAR$^2$ outperforms baseline approaches (up to 2.75 pp.) in every setting on nine zero-shot benchmarks, with larger advantages (up to 2.72 pp. higher) under more aggressive pruning (up to 50%).
arxiv.titleZh: GEAR²：被剪枝专家借助激活专家的门控复用与缺失质量残差继续生效
arxiv.summaryZh: MoE大模型做专家剪枝可省显存，但被剪专家的贡献被直接丢弃，静态替代、专家合并或恢复训练各有代价。GEAR用可靠激活专家的缩放输出做门控复用，无需训练也不增加专家计算；GEAR²再叠加一个超轻量残差，补足复用无法表达的部分。在5个16B–106B参数的MoE模型、25%与50%剪枝率下，GEAR在几乎所有设定上优于免训练基线（最高4个百分点），GEAR²在九个零样本基准的每个设定上均超过基线（最高2.75个百分点），50%激进剪枝下优势更明显。该方案可作为即插即用组件降低MoE部署的显存开销。
arxiv.reason: MoE专家剪枝，免训练复用激活专家，覆盖16B–106B多模型

arxiv.title: Same Papers, Different Verdicts: Tracing Version Drift in LLM Peer Review
arxiv.abstract: Venues and benchmarks read LLM review scores as measurements of a paper, while providers replace their models within months. We audit twenty frontier models from OpenAI, Google and Anthropic on ICLR 2027 submissions while they were under review, with tests registered before the decisions. Between an earlier and a later version of Claude Opus and of Gemini, the share of papers placed on the accept side falls by 52 and 53 percentage points on 183 and 60 randomly drawn submissions, and by 43 to 79 points in six further paired comparisons, with no paper moving up in any of them. Stating a 30% acceptance rate in the prompt leaves a gap of 79 points between the two Opus versions. When score-stripped critiques are swapped between versions, the later critiques alone lower the accept share by 35 points for Opus and 51 for Gemini; for Opus the drop is 35 points under a third-party scorer and 24 after a rewrite that keeps each technical point and removes evaluative wording. On 57 papers, the percentiles of Opus 4.6 and 5.5 correlate at 0.73 while their accept shares differ by 44 points. On 99 to 119 submissions, the self-estimated percentiles of three models correlate with two human reviewers more strongly than a third reviewer does (point estimates 0.17 to 0.21, 95% intervals between -0.04 and +0.42). All twenty models give a 2 or a 3 in 473 of their 475 reviews, against 60 of 72 human reviews. Retrospective tests on decided papers can draw on memory. Claude Opus 5.5 names the true first author of 27 decided ICLR 2026 papers from their titles alone, with no wrong name, and Claude Opus 4.6 accepted all 11 decided papers it said it recognized, against 5 expected. Thresholds on LLM-reviewer scores therefore have to be validated against human decisions for each model version; our tests against the ICLR 2027 decisions follow on 16 December 2026.
arxiv.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Results of the registered tests that need the ICLR 2027 decisions will be added after 16 December 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 同一批论文，不同裁决:追踪 LLM 同行评审中的版本漂移
arxiv.summaryZh: 把 LLM 评审分数当作论文的测量值，而模型供应商数月即换代，分数因而不可比。研究者在 ICLR 2027 审稿期内、决策前预注册测试，审计 OpenAI、Google、Anthropic 共 20 个前沿模型:Claude Opus 与 Gemini 的前后版本把判为接收侧的论文比例分别压低 52 与 53 个百分点(样本分别为 183 与 60 篇)，另六组配对比较的降幅为 43–79 点且无一上升;prompt 写明 30% 接收率仍留 79 点差距，仅交换去分批评即令 Opus 降 35 点、Gemini 降 51 点。Opus 4.6 与 5.5 的百分位相关 0.73，接收份额却差 44 点。结论是 LLM 评审分数的阈值必须逐个模型版本对人类决策校准。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-judge 可靠性审计，命中评测方法学方向

arxiv.title: Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents answer questions by calling APIs and trusting the results. An API can fail silently. It ignores part of a request, such as a misnamed filter, yet returns HTTP 200 and a plausible but wrong result. Current fixes, such as checklists, reviewer models and LLM judges, ask the model to catch it. But models often see the problem and answer anyway. We present SilentGuard, which moves the decision from the model to the harness running tool calls. It tests each result against invariants that any correct API must satisfy and withholds values that break one. We find silent failures in 11 of 15 public research APIs, with counts inflated up to 691 times. Current fixes leave over 70% of answers wrong, and agents report 77.4% of counts a judge flags. Across 7 open models, SilentGuard cuts wrong answers on its target faults from 74.0% to 1.7%, with no loss on fault-free tasks. On three frontier models they fall from 70.2% to 0.5%. A warning from the same check leaves 70.1% wrong, so enforcement is the key. On new fault types, the harness alone cuts wrong answers from 61.1% to 24.5%. It avoids wrong answers by abstaining rather than recovering.
arxiv.titleZh: 以不变量感知的 Harness 强制执行保护 LLM Agent 免受 API 静默失败
arxiv.summaryZh: API 静默失败指接口忽略请求中的部分参数（如过滤器名写错），却仍返回 HTTP 200 和看似合理的结果，而 Agent 会直接采信这些值。SilentGuard 把判断权从模型移交给执行工具调用的 harness：用任何正确 API 都必须满足的不变量逐条校验每次返回，一旦违反就不向下游放行对应取值。在 15 个公开科研 API 中的 11 个发现静默失败，计数最高虚增 691 倍；现有清单、审稿模型与 LLM judge 方案仍有逾 70% 答案错误，且 Agent 会照报 77.4% 已被 judge 标记的计数。在 7 个开源模型上，目标故障的错答率从 74.0% 降至 1.7%，无故障任务无损失，3 个前沿模型从 70.2% 降至 0.5%；仅给警告仍有 70.1% 错误，说明强制执行才是关键；对新型故障，仅靠 harness 可将错答从 61.1% 降至 24.5%，代价是以弃答而非恢复来规避错误。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工具调用的 harness 级防护，系统性强、结果扎实，直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: RoShift: Lazy Shift and Weight-aware Rotation for Activation Sparsity in LLM Inference
arxiv.abstract: Activation sparsity accelerates LLM decoding by skipping unnecessary weight reads and computation. However, SiLU-based LLMs exhibit little natural sparsity, and imposing high sparsity can substantially degrade accuracy. We propose RoShift, a training-free method that transforms activations into sparsity-friendly representations. RoShift introduces lazy shift, which recenters SiLU activation distributions around zero and defers correction to the end of the FFN to obtain additional sparsity. It also reduces sparsification-induced output error through rotation that jointly accounts for activation and weight information. By fusing the corrections required for shifting and rotation, RoShift translates these gains into decoding speedup. At 50% and 60% sparsity, RoShift improves average accuracy over TEAL by 1.60 and 3.29 percentage points, respectively, across five models. It achieves up to $1.72\times$ decoding speedup over the dense model on an RTX 5090 at 50% sparsity and yields a better accuracy-speedup Pareto frontier than TEAL. Code is available at https://github.com/hulahula3247/RoShift
arxiv.titleZh: RoShift：面向 LLM 推理激活稀疏性的惰性移位与权重感知旋转
arxiv.summaryZh: SiLU 类 LLM 的激活自然稀疏性很低，强制高稀疏会显著掉点。RoShift 是一种免训练方法：先对激活做惰性移位（lazy shift），把 SiLU 激活分布重新对准零点，并把修正推迟到 FFN 末端，以换取额外稀疏；再用同时考虑激活与权重信息的旋转（rotation）降低稀疏化引起的输出误差。两项修正被融合在一起，从而转化为实际解码加速。在五个模型上，50% 与 60% 稀疏度下平均准确率分别较 TEAL 提升 1.60 与 3.29 个百分点，RTX 5090 上 50% 稀疏度时解码最高加速 1.72 倍，准确率-加速比 Pareto 前沿优于 TEAL。
arxiv.reason: 免训练激活稀疏加速推理，机制清晰有实测加速，属高效推理方向

arxiv.title: GaugeRoPE: RoPE-Compatible Executable Latent Attention
arxiv.abstract: Latent KV cache compression reduces memory footprint by mapping historical keys and values into compact representations. However, generic compressed key states require reconstruction to native dimension before applying RoPE and computing attention scores, adding sequence-scaling overhead to the decode path. We characterize when a latent KV representation can serve directly as the execution state of pretrained RoPE. For RoPE-based transformers, exact static linear execution of the rotary key path requires the latent-to-native map to preserve the pretrained RoPE action through an intertwining relation, restricting exact mixing to coordinates that share the same RoPE frequency. Guided by this characterization, we build GaugeRoPE, a training-free executable latent KV representation. It combines a RoPE-compatible carrier that preserves the rotary action with an approximate position-independent residual key--value (RKV) correction for complementary key and value information, both evaluated without per-token dense historical K/V reconstruction. On Mistral-7B, GaugeRoPE achieves $5.85\times$ KV compression while maintaining quality close to the full-cache baseline. Additional MHA results validate the construction beyond GQA. GaugeRoPE achieves up to $2.48\times$ the decode throughput of the vanilla uncompressed baseline through direct latent execution.
arxiv.titleZh: GaugeRoPE:与 RoPE 兼容的可执行潜在注意力
arxiv.summaryZh: 潜在 KV 缓存压缩需先把压缩后的键状态还原到原生维度，才能施加 RoPE 并计算注意力分数，解码路径因此多出随序列长度增长的开销。GaugeRoPE 刻画了潜在表示可直接充当预训练 RoPE 执行状态的条件:精确的静态线性执行要求潜在到原生的映射通过 intertwining 关系保持预训练的旋转作用，从而把可精确混合的坐标限制在共享同一 RoPE 频率的维度上。据此构造免训练的 RoPE 兼容载体，并辅以位置无关的残差键值(RKV)修正补足键与值信息，全程不做逐 token 的稠密历史 K/V 重建。在 Mistral-7B 上实现 5.85× KV 压缩且质量接近全缓存基线，解码吞吐最高为未压缩基线的 2.48×，并在 MHA 上验证了构造的通用性。
arxiv.reason: 针对 RoPE 兼容的潜在 KV 压缩与解码加速，方法新颖且含理论刻画

arxiv.title: TrainExplorer: Autonomous LLM Post-Training via Plan-and-Decouple Exploration
arxiv.abstract: LLM-based agents can automate model post-training, accelerating progress toward recursive self-improvement. Despite their promise, existing approaches remain under-explored and face two main challenges: (1) strategy lock-in that limits exploration beyond the initial strategy; and (2) coupled execution that obscures the effects of individual modifications. To address these challanges, we propose TrainExplorer, a multi-agent framework for autonomous post-training, that incorporates strategy planning and execution decoupling, to achieve broaden strategy exploration. First, strategy planning draws on scientific literature to construct a candidate search space of training strategies. Then, decoupled execution enables single-component interventions and attribution to guide strategy exploration. Extensive experiments on PostTrainBench demonstrate that TrainExplorer achieves a weighted aggregate score of 39.02, outperforming Claude Code using the same LLM by 7.32 and surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol-powered Codex, which scores 36.23. Code will be available.
arxiv.titleZh: TrainExplorer:通过「规划—解耦」探索实现自主 LLM 后训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 LLM 智能体自动做后训练时存在两个问题:容易锁定在初始策略、难以探索更广的策略空间;执行过程彼此耦合，使单项修改的效果难以归因。TrainExplorer 采用多智能体框架，先将科学文献中的训练策略组织成候选搜索空间用于策略规划，再以解耦执行支持单组件干预与效果归因，从而引导策略探索。在 PostTrainBench 上，其加权综合得分为 39.02，比使用同一 LLM 的 Claude Code 高 7.32，并超过由 GPT-5.6 Sol 驱动的 Codex(36.23)。该工作为自动化后训练与递归自我改进提供了可归因、可扩展的实验范式。
arxiv.reason: 自主后训练智能体，同时覆盖后训练与 Agent 探索，系统性强

arxiv.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier
arxiv.abstract: When high-quality data runs out, a common practice is to train on it for several epochs, but each repeat is worth less than the last. Latent feedback, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, is another way to spend that compute, yet it has not been tested against a vanilla Transformer that spends the same compute on more epochs. We run this test across a ladder of model sizes, unique data and epochs, tuning both models at every size and amount of unique data. Latent feedback makes every FLOP and every token count for more except when unique data is scarce relative to model size, a regime that today's models are far from. We find that latent feedback serves as an amplifier: with unique data fixed, it reaches a Transformer's loss with less compute; with epochs fixed, it reaches that loss with less unique data. Furthermore, both savings grow with unique data per parameter and with repetition, and downstream tasks agree. To go beyond our grid, we fit one scaling law to both models, in which latent feedback enters as a Transformer with more parameters; it predicts that both savings keep growing with unique data and repetition. Fitted on models from 60M to 271M parameters, the law predicts the losses at a held-out 778M size to within 0.3% and the gap between the two models to within 0.05%. At most, latent feedback saves 48% of the compute and 47% of the unique data. When data, not compute, is the limit, latent feedback is the better use of a FLOP for a model of a given size.
arxiv.titleZh: 潜在反馈是算力与数据的放大器
arxiv.summaryZh: 高质量数据耗尽后重复训练多个 epoch 收益递减，该工作把每个 token 的顶层隐状态回灌到下一 token 的输入(潜在反馈)，并在模型规模、唯一数据量、epoch 构成的网格上逐点调参，与同等算力下多跑 epoch 的 Transformer 正面对比。结果显示两类节省随「每参数量唯一数据」与重复次数增长:固定唯一数据可省最多 48% 算力，固定 epoch 可省最多 47% 唯一数据，下游任务结论一致。单一 scaling law 把潜在反馈等价为参数更多的 Transformer，在 60M–271M 上拟合后，对留出 778M 规模的损失预测误差在 0.3% 以内、两模型差距误差在 0.05% 以内。仅当唯一数据相对模型规模极度稀缺时该方法失效，而当前模型远未处于该区间，故数据受限场景下潜在反馈是更划算的 FLOP 用法。
arxiv.reason: 预训练新架构机制并配统一 scaling law，直击 LLM 架构方向

arxiv.title: Attention Sinks as Spectral Spikes: A Mechanism Analysis of Gated Attention
arxiv.abstract: Transformer attention exhibits attention sinks, where a small subset of source tokens absorbs disproportionate attention mass across layers. Recent work shows that post-SDPA output gating strongly reduces attention-sink behavior, while separate studies link attention sinks to gradient sinks and massive activations through backward training dynamics. Yet how the same gate affects forward sink structure, backward gradient concentration, and training-time representation signatures remains unclear. We address this gap by formulating attention sinks as sink-induced low-rank modes in token-space covariance, with directions aligned to high-mass attention columns. Under this view, post-SDPA gating acts as a mode-dependent contraction: it attenuates sink-induced spectral energy in the forward pass and locally reduces value-path gradients routed through sink columns in the backward pass. Empirically, random-matrix diagnostics show that gating reduces outlier mass, weakens sink-subspace alignment, and increases effective rank, while backward analyses show active-gate attenuation of first-token value gradients. Training-time diagnostics further show that gating suppresses the co-emergence of attention concentration, value-gradient amplification, and representation dominance.
arxiv.comment: The 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
arxiv.titleZh: 注意力汇即谱尖峰:门控注意力的机制分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对少数源token跨层吸收过多注意力、即attention sink的现象，把attention sink刻画为token空间协方差中由sink诱导的低秩模态，其方向对齐高注意力质量的列;在此视角下，post-SDPA门控表现为模态依赖的收缩，前向衰减sink谱能量，反向局部削弱经sink列传导的值路径梯度。随机矩阵诊断显示门控降低离群质量、削弱sink子空间对齐并提升有效秩，反向分析观察到首token值梯度被激活门衰减，训练期诊断进一步表明门控抑制了注意力集中、值梯度放大与表示主导三者的共现。
arxiv.reason: 注意力汇与门控机制的可解释性分析，命中架构与训练稳定性

arxiv.title: CertiSum: Bitwise-Identical MXFP4 Training Across Platforms and Parallelism Layouts
arxiv.abstract: Training with MXFP4, a 4-bit microscaling format, is non-deterministic: identical inputs can produce different results across parallelism layouts and GPU vendors. These differences complicate debugging and training audits and can cause training and inference engines to disagree. We present CertiSum to make MXFP4 training bitwise invariant across runs, parallelism layouts, and GPU vendors. Its key insight is that native FP32 accumulation of MXFP4 products is often already exact for every summation order. CertiSum collects statistics during quantization to certify native matrix multiplication results, recomputes uncertified outputs exactly, and uses exact kernels directly where certification rarely succeeds. CertiSum keeps quantization blocks unchanged across layouts and merges partial sums without rounding, including in attention and weight-gradient computation. In 200-step Qwen3-8B-Base experiments, CertiSum preserves training states bit for bit across AMD MI350X and NVIDIA GB200 and across changes in data, tensor, and context parallelism on MI350X. Across three 8B--14B models on FineWeb-Edu using MI350X, it adds 11.8--60.5% to training-step latency relative to its non-exact MXFP4 counterpart at the larger evaluated input shapes, with speedups of up to $1.24\times$ over BF16 and $1.70\times$ over deterministic BF16.
arxiv.titleZh: CertiSum：跨平台与并行布局下位级完全一致的 MXFP4 训练
arxiv.summaryZh: MXFP4 训练存在非确定性：相同输入在不同并行布局与不同 GPU 厂商上会得到不同结果，给调试、训练审计以及训练引擎与推理引擎的一致性带来麻烦。CertiSum 的核心观察是，MXFP4 乘积的 FP32 原生累加在多数求和顺序下本就精确；它在量化阶段收集统计量，对原生矩阵乘结果做认证，仅对未认证输出进行精确重算，并在认证难以成功的场景直接采用精确 kernel，同时保持量化块跨布局不变、部分和无舍入合并（含 attention 与权重梯度计算）。在 Qwen3-8B-Base 的 200 步实验中，CertiSum 在 AMD MI350X 与 NVIDIA GB200 之间、以及 MI350X 上数据／张量／上下文并行变化时均实现训练状态逐位一致；在三个 8B–14B 模型上，较大输入形状下相对非精确 MXFP4 增加 11.8%–60.5% 的单步延迟，同时相对 BF16 最高提速 1.24 倍、相对确定性 BF16 最高提速 1.70 倍。该工作为低精度训练提供了可审计、可跨平台复现的确定性方案。
arxiv.reason: 低精度训练确定性，命中高效训练与量化方向

arxiv.title: Procedure without Judgment: What Small Language Models Learn under an Exact Verifier
arxiv.abstract: When an authorization policy blocks an agent's tool call, the audit log should name the facts that forced the decision and nothing more. For an executable policy over an enumerable context space this minimal sufficient reason can be computed exactly, so an explanation is scored against ground truth rather than a proxy for it. We use that exactness to ask what a model can learn from a verifier that has no error in it. The explainer sees one request and one decision, never the policy, and has thirty turns in which it may call the policy on altered requests and ask whether a candidate set of facts is sufficient. Frontier models find the exact reason about half the time with the tools alone, and one sentence telling them to shrink the answer lifts Haiku 4.5 from 58% to 75%. A 4B model fine-tuned on 2000 traces of the deletion algorithm reaches 92% on the policy it was trained on. Teacher kind is what moves this: at matched data size the algorithm-taught student leads the frontier-taught one in all three training seeds, and the two arms never overlap. What the student learns is a fixed schedule of sufficiency checks, and the schedule does not travel. On three public policies it never saw, its answers stay sufficient (94%) and stop being minimal (48%), while Haiku under the same sentence is exact on all 47 episodes. Reinforcement learning from the exact reward leaves held-out accuracy where it was and inverts the strategy, from probing the policy to spending the entire budget on sufficiency checks. The oracle made the effect of training legible, but it did not make training better.
arxiv.titleZh: 无判断的程序：小型语言模型在精确验证器下学到了什么
arxiv.summaryZh: 授权策略拦截工具调用时，审计日志需给出最小充分的事实集合；在可枚举上下文空间上，该最小理由可精确计算，因此解释能对照真值评分，而非依赖代理指标。实验设置中解释器只看到单个请求与决策、看不到策略本身，可在三十轮内调用策略并提出候选事实集询问充分性。前沿模型仅靠工具约有半数能找到精确理由，加入一句「缩小答案」的提示后 Haiku 4.5 从 58% 升至 75%；在 2000 条删除算法轨迹上微调的 4B 模型在训练策略上达到 92%，且算法教学在所有三个随机种子下都优于前沿模型教学。但学生学到的是一套固定的充分性检查流程：在三个未见过的公开策略上答案仍充分（94%）却不再最小（48%），同样提示下 Haiku 在全部 47 个回合上精确；直接用精确奖励做 RL 未提升留出准确率，只把策略从探测改判为耗尽预算做充分性检查。
arxiv.reason: 可验证奖励加小模型后训练与工具调用，方法清晰但实验规模偏小

arxiv.title: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
arxiv.abstract: A useful memory need not resemble the question it helps answer. Jetriever ranks each stored memory by Jev's decision score for its usefulness to the current question, replacing similarity search with full-pool utility scoring. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, it places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases; matched BM25 and MiniLM controls reach 1.6% and 0.0% when indexing user turns. A 20-question comparison separates finding evidence from ranking it: Jev and Qwen3.5 9B each find 90% of gold exchanges by rank 50, while Laya finds 30%; at rank one, Jev reaches 85% and Qwen3.5 9B 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever's four-dimension score is 55.4%, against 44.3% for ReFind on the same questions. Jev retrieval costs USD 0.00834 per InMind question and USD 0.03103 per MAB question on average. These results show the value of world knowledge, scores that rank decisive memories first, and affordable full-pool scoring.
arxiv.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Project repository: https://github.com/imlrz/Jetriever
arxiv.titleZh: Jetriever：把 Agent 记忆检索从相似度转向效用
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Agent 记忆检索依赖相似度、而真正有用的记忆往往与问题并不相似的问题，改为对全部记忆池逐条打分，用 Jev 决策分数衡量每条记忆对当前问题的有用性并据此排序，取代向量或 BM25 相似度检索。在 InMind 的 125 个间接查询任务上，金标记忆排首位率 84.8%，同条件 BM25 与 MiniLM 仅 1.6% 与 0.0%；在 MemoryAgentBench 的 60 题分层抽样上四维得分 55.4%，高于 ReFind 的 44.3%，单题检索成本约 0.008 至 0.031 美元。结果说明世界知识与「把决定性记忆排到最前」的评分方式有效，且全池打分在成本上可行。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆检索改为效用全池打分，方向对口但实验规模有限

arxiv.title: Anytime-Valid PAC-Bayes Certificates for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling
arxiv.abstract: Test-time scaling systems often choose how much to sample, which prompt to use, and which verifier or aggregation rule to trust after repeatedly inspecting a calibration set. Standard validation error bars are not valid after this adaptive selection. We model a test-time scaling recipe as a randomized predictor with a random cost and prove a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that holds simultaneously over all calibration times, all posterior mixtures over recipes, and all data-dependent stopping rules. Thus the same event covers the recipe search that precedes deployment, not merely the fixed recipe finally reported. For a finite grid of budgets and verifiers, the penalty is the familiar $\log M/n$, which in the worst case no certificate valid after selection can avoid, while non-uniform priors and localized posterior mixtures can give sharper certificates for structured searches. We specialize the result to self-consistency and show a complementary margin law: plurality voting improves exponentially in the sample budget only on examples where the correct answer is the generator's unique mode; otherwise more compute can provably amplify errors. The same margin analysis yields an oracle water-filling law for compute allocation. A synthetic audit quantifies the optimism caused by adaptive budget selection, and a 192-example GSM8K audit using gpt-4.1-mini generations illustrates risk-cost reporting for a real inference pipeline. At scale, with two models on GSM8K and MATH-500, selected-best error bars fall below the out-of-split GSM8K risk in up to 22.5% of random splits at a nominal 5% while the certificate never does, and on the full GSM8K test split it tightens to 0.109 (held-out risk 0.039). The results give a lightweight, distribution-free way to report risk and compute claims for adaptive inference systems.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Xiaoyu Li and Jiangxuan Long contributed equally. 31 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 自适应测试时扩展的随时有效PAC-Bayes证书
arxiv.summaryZh: 测试时扩展常在反复查看校准集后才决定采样预算、提示与验证器，标准验证误差棒在此类自适应选择后失效。工作把扩展配方建模为带随机代价的随机预测器，给出在全部校准时刻、配方后验混合与数据依赖停止规则上同时成立的时间一致PAC-Bayes保证，有限网格下惩罚为最优的log M/n。针对自洽性得到边际律：多数投票仅在正确答案为生成器唯一众数时随预算指数改进，否则增加算力会放大错误，并给出算力分配的oracle注水律。GSM8K与MATH-500上，名义5%下选优误差棒在最多22.5%的随机划分中低于留出风险，而该保证从不失效。
arxiv.reason: 测试时扩展的自适应选择统计保证，直击评估可靠性

arxiv.title: Same Fix, Different Weights: Replicating Weight-Space Programming with Claude
arxiv.abstract: Takehi et al. (2026) report that GPT-6 Astra, given the weights of small neural networks as text, can say what they were trained to do, repair them, and write new ones without training. I re-ran the core of that study with Claude Opus 5.5 in ten pre-registered experiments, with untrained-network and permutation controls and hand audits of every sandboxed code cell. Reading was mixed: Claude named 3 of 4 Atari games from policy weights and found the measured copying heads in 15/15 character-LM runs, but its answers about training data often followed priors. Unlike the original, it identified a sycophantic Gemma 3 270M finetune from weights alone in 6/6 runs. One-shot weight edits took a failing MountainCar policy from 0% to 100% success and a hovering LunarLander policy from 0% to 85.6%; zero-shot networks beat PPO at 100k steps on 4 of 5 environments, each implementing a textbook controller. With no training or forward passes, Claude wrote a 1.48M-parameter 9x9 Go network that won 85-94% of games against three PPO opponents. Given Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights and 10, 25 or 50 forward passes of 64 practice problems, Claude raised MATH-500 from 6.7% to 51.4%, 55.2% and 58.1% (+51.4 points at 50 passes, 95% CI [47.9, 55.0]; original 48.1%), GSM8K from 11.6% to 68.2% and IFEval from 22.2% to 54.2%. Unlike the original, which removed an internal loop direction, every edit acted at the output: it scaled the final norm, raising the effective sampling temperature, and lowered the logit of "Wait" while raising that of </think>. The norm scaling alone reaches only 20.9-22.1% on MATH-500. On Gemma 3 270M, which rarely loops, no edit helped (-0.8 points), as in the original.
arxiv.titleZh: 同样的修复，不同的权重：用 Claude 复现权重空间编程
arxiv.summaryZh: 检验前沿模型能否把小型网络的权重当作文本读懂、修复，并免训练写出新网络：用 Claude Opus 5.5 在十项预注册实验中复现原研究，加入未训练网络与置换对照，并人工审计每段沙箱代码。Claude 能从策略权重中认出 4 个 Atari 游戏中的 3 个，在 15/15 次字符级语言模型运行中定位到复制头，6/6 次仅凭权重识别出谄媚微调的 Gemma 3 270M；单次权重编辑把 MountainCar 成功率从 0% 提到 100%、LunarLander 从 0% 提到 85.6%，不做前向传播即写出 1.48M 参数 9x9 Go 网络，对三个 PPO 对手胜率 85–94%。对 Qwen3.5-0.8B，仅给权重与 50 次、每次 64 题的前向，就把 MATH-500 从 6.7% 提到 58.1%，GSM8K 从 11.6% 到 68.2%。与原研究不同，所有有效编辑都作用在输出端，即缩放 final norm、压低「Wait」logit。
arxiv.reason: 权重空间编程的严格复现，免训练权重编辑直击自我改进方向

arxiv.title: DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds
arxiv.abstract: Benchmarks judge language-model agents mainly by whether they reach the correct final state, not by how they got there. Endpoint scoring cannot separate an agent that retrieved exactly the evidence a decision required from one that read most of the environment, nor an agent that never located the evidence from one that stopped a single action short. Settling this needs a reference cost, and authored solutions establish only that a task is solvable, not that no shorter route exists. We present DetourBench, which constrains the environment until that minimum is computable. Each task is a finite, partially observable transition system with unit-cost accesses whose resources become globally addressable after discovery. Exhaustive search yields the full-information minimum action count $L_0$ with a replayable witness; from graph-recoverable terminal states it also yields exact residual work $R_T$, which separates an episode that stopped one access short from one that wandered, while an irreversible wrong commitment is recorded as having no finite residual distance rather than assigned one. Success, attainment, residual progress, and normalized detour are reported separately. Across 375 scored episodes --- five model endpoints, 25 integrated tasks, three repeats --- success ranges from 58.7% to 96.0% while conditional attainment ranges from 0.803 to 0.890 and orders the models differently. Among recoverable failures, residual work separates near-complete trajectories from costly incompletion and from irreversible commitment. We open-source the instances, oracle witnesses, and evaluation harness at https://github.com/DatagridsAI/DetourBench.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Evaluation of Interactive Agents
arxiv.titleZh: DetourBench：交互式智能体的轨迹级评估与精确最小动作下界
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有benchmark主要以是否到达正确终态评判语言模型智能体，无法区分恰好检索到必要证据与遍历大半环境、或只差一步与彻底迷路。DetourBench把环境约束为有限、部分可观察的单位代价转移系统，用穷举搜索得到全信息最小动作数L0及可回放见证，并对可恢复终态计算精确剩余工作量R_T，将成功、达成度、剩余进度与归一化绕路分别报告。在五个模型端点、25个任务、三次重复共375个计分回合上，成功率58.7%–96.0%，条件达成度0.803–0.890且模型排序与成功率不一致；剩余工作量还能区分接近完成、代价高昂的未完成与不可逆错误承诺。
arxiv.reason: Agent轨迹级评测，指标设计新颖，直击评估可靠性方向

arxiv.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
arxiv.abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash drafter. With DFlash, Bolt E4B achieves $2.74\times$ the per-user decode speed of inference without speculative decoding at concurrency~1, and $1.21\times$ the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size 1.
arxiv.comment: Animated versions of Figure 3 are available in the blog: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/nemotron/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB/
arxiv.titleZh: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB:一个面向快速对话 Agent 的开放高效小语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向本地与边缘设备上快速对话助手的每 GB 显存效率问题，在 Gemma-4-E4B-it 基础上继续后训练得到 4GB 级小模型，强化多轮工具调用、指令跟随与输入 grounding。在 21 个 benchmark 上的实验显示，其在推理与非推理两种模式下平均准确率最高且输出 token 最少，优于 Gemma-4-E4B-it 与 Qwen3.5-4B。模型随附 DFlash 投机解码 drafter，并发为 1 时单用户解码速度达到无投机解码的 2.74 倍，batch size 1 时生成吞吐为带 MTP 的 Gemma-4-E4B-it 的 1.21 倍。
arxiv.reason: 小模型后训练加多轮工具调用与投机解码，同时命中后训练与效率方向

arxiv.title: AgentFaultBench: State-Verified Evaluation of Tool-Fault Recovery
arxiv.abstract: Does recovery advice help an agent finish a task after a tool fails? AgentFaultBench evaluates LangGraph and CrewAI agents performing specified tasks in an isolated GitLab installation. We inject tool errors and check both the resulting files and issues and the required reads, verification and final response. The prompt supplies the expected issue and report text, so the task tests execution rather than content generation. In the primary comparison of 1,944 planned runs, advice changes success by -8.33, 0.00 and +1.06 percentage points relative to a neutral reminder; missing outcomes leave the latter two comparisons inconclusive. Later experiments test a revised recovery policy. GPT-4o mini improves, while Sol and Claude already complete the recoverable cases. In a separate 624-run study on six related tasks not previously used by that policy, the guided condition records 161 correct final states and one unknown outcome in 192 planned runs, versus 142/192 with neutral feedback. The gain lies between +9.90 and +10.42 pp when missing outcomes are included. Removing issue IDs gives 47/48 successes versus 46/48 with IDs; other execution information remains. A second checker agrees on 1,879 observed primary outcomes and 241 constructed test cases. No human validation was collected. The findings support testing advice against explicit recovery controls rather than assuming it helps.
arxiv.comment: 63 pages, 7 figures, including appendices. Submitted to the NAACL 2027 Industry Track
arxiv.titleZh: AgentFaultBench:状态可验证的工具故障恢复评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察工具调用失败后 agent 能否真正把任务做完，以及事后给出的恢复建议是否真有帮助。在隔离的 GitLab 环境中向 LangGraph 与 CrewAI agent 注入工具错误，并校验最终文件、issue 以及必需的读取、验证与最终回复;prompt 已给出期望的 issue 与报告文本，因此测的是执行而非内容生成。主对照的 1944 次计划运行中，建议相对中性提醒使成功率变化 -8.33、0.00、+1.06 个百分点;在六个未参与策略修订的任务上共 624 次运行，引导条件 192 次计划运行中有 161 次正确最终状态，中性反馈为 142/192，增益约 +9.9 至 +10.4 个百分点;去掉 issue ID 后为 47/48 对 46/48。结论是恢复建议应与显式恢复控制对照验证，不能默认有效。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工具故障恢复 benchmark，命中 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Contrastive Activation-Guided Zeroth-Order Preference Optimisation for Memory-Efficient LLM Alignment
arxiv.abstract: Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) simplifies reinforcement learning from human feedback, but still relies on traditional backpropagation and its associated activation-memory cost. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimisation avoids backpropagation, yet isotropic perturbations can produce noisy updates for preference objectives defined by differences between chosen and rejected responses. We introduce Contrastive Activation-guided Zeroth-Order Direct Preference Optimisation (CA-ZODPO), which constructs a low-rank search subspace from the activation discrepancy between the chosen and rejected responses in each preference pair. Perturbations are restricted to this subspace, while momentum is maintained in low-rank coordinates to preserve the memory advantages of ZO training. On Qwen2.5-1.5B with Anthropic HH-RLHF, CA-ZODPO outperforms common ZO baselines and remains competitive with first-order DPO in pairwise preference evaluation. It also reduces peak GPU memory by about 59\% at a sequence length of 2048 while retaining the sequence-length scaling behaviour of zeroth-order training.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向显存高效LLM对齐的对比激活引导零阶偏好优化
arxiv.summaryZh: DPO依赖反向传播，激活显存开销大；零阶优化虽免反向传播，但各向同性扰动在偏好目标上噪声大。CA-ZODPO从每条偏好对中chosen与rejected响应的激活差异构造低秩搜索子空间，把扰动限制在该子空间内，并在低秩坐标上维护动量以保持零阶训练的显存优势。在Qwen2.5-1.5B与Anthropic HH-RLHF上，该方法在成对偏好评估中优于常见零阶基线，与一阶DPO相当，序列长度2048时峰值显存降低约59%，并保留零阶训练的序列长度扩展特性。
arxiv.reason: 零阶DPO显存高效对齐，属后训练方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: AdMem: Expectation-Grounded Procedural Memory for Long-Horizon Task-Solving Agents
arxiv.abstract: An agent that carries memory across tasks is only as good as the entries it keeps. We begin from an observation that is easy to reproduce and uncomfortable for the field: naively accumulating cross-task experience can make an agent \emph{worse} than one with no memory at all. On AgentBoard, a workflow-induction memory solves fewer tasks than a memoryless ReAct agent in seven of eight domains, and a per-step procedural store with no surrounding structure loses half of ReAct's completions on Jericho. We argue that the missing ingredients are per-action credit assignment and an explicit life cycle for stored entries, and present AdMem, which supplies both. Before each action the actor commits to an expected outcome; a concurrently running critic scores the realized outcome against that expectation and writes a procedural entry carrying a binary reward and a reflection, so credit lands on the action that earned it and no environment reward is required. Each entry then carries a scalar utility, updated online under a noisy-OR reward model, that ranks retrieval jointly with context similarity and drives eviction and merging, giving the store a forgetting and consolidation policy instead of unbounded growth. Across 707 tasks in eight AgentBoard domains AdMem solves 441 against 388 for ReAct and 312 for the workflow-induction baseline --- a pooled gain significant under a two-sided Fisher exact test, concentrated in the domains that supply transferable cross-task structure. All memory stays human-readable text, which is what makes the failures above diagnosable --- and, as we discuss, also makes the store an auditable but attackable surface.
arxiv.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond
arxiv.titleZh: AdMem：面向长时程任务求解智能体的期望锚定过程记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 跨任务记忆并非越多越好：在 AgentBoard 的八个域中有七个，工作流归纳记忆反而不如无记忆 ReAct；在 Jericho 上，缺乏结构的过程存储会丢掉 ReAct 一半的完成量。AdMem 让执行者在每个动作前提交期望结果，并由并行的评论者按期望给实际结果打二元奖励、写入带反思的过程条目，实现逐动作信用分配；每条目维护在线更新的标量效用（噪声 OR 奖励模型），与上下文相似度联合排序检索，并驱动淘汰与合并。在八个域共 707 个任务上解决 441 个，ReAct 为 388，工作流归纳基线为 312，合并增益在双侧 Fisher 精确检验下显著。记忆全部为可读文本，便于诊断，也使其成为可审计但可攻击的面。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆机制与信用分配，命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Reasoning Again with a Quarter of the Experts: Retry First, Then Train
arxiv.abstract: Removing three quarters of the routed experts from a 122B-parameter reasoning mixture-of-experts model makes it fit in a 12 GiB file, and breaks it in a specific way: on LiveCodeBench it enters verbatim reasoning loops that run to the token limit on 44 of 120 development problems, where the unpruned model at the same 2-bit quantization loops on none. We study how much of that loss can be recovered without changing the kept experts' quantized bytes, in three steps of increasing cost. On development problems, a sampling penalty recovers part of it. Stopping a reply when it starts to loop and drawing again recovers more on top of it, with no weight change. Our method, B, adds rank-8 trained corrections to the kept experts, loaded as an adapter, and restores two experts per layer; it is fitted layer by layer to the unpruned model's expert block on the pruned model's own activations. In a pre-registered comparison on 130 easy and medium LiveCodeBench problems that no part of the study had touched, with both arms given the same sampling penalty and the same stop-and-redraw policy, B solves 116 problems against 104 (+9.2 pp, 95% CI [+3.1, +15.4]; 15 problems gained, 3 lost). A training-free weight edit aimed at the loops, tested the same way earlier, did not help. B removes more wrong answers than loops, and costs 1.7x the wall time. On two older benchmarks used as regression checks, B stays inside a pre-set 2 pp tolerance but shows no gain (HumanEval+ +0.6 pp, MBPP+ -1.9 pp). The evidence is one model, one quantization and one benchmark family; we state what it does and does not show.
arxiv.titleZh: 用四分之一的专家再次推理：先重试，再训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 从122B参数的MoE推理模型剪掉四分之三路由专家并压到12GiB后，模型在LiveCodeBench上陷入复读式循环（120题中44题跑满token上限），而同等2-bit量化的未剪枝模型无一循环。三级恢复依次为采样惩罚、检测到循环即停止重采样（不改权重），以及叠加在保留专家上的rank-8适配器并恢复每层两个专家——以未剪枝模型专家块为目标、在剪枝模型自身激活上逐层拟合，称方案B。在130道未参与设计的简单/中等题上，B解出116题对104题（+9.2pp，95% CI [+3.1, +15.4]），代价为1.7倍耗时；HumanEval+/MBPP+在2pp容差内持平。
arxiv.reason: MoE剪枝与量化后的推理循环修复，效率方向扎实但仅单模型单基准

arxiv.title: JointQ: Joint Scale-and-Integer Quantization for Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: GPTQ is the de facto standard solver for layer-wise post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models, yet the solver itself has received less attention than weight preprocessing and cross-layer objectives. We target a bottleneck of GPTQ: its greedy procedure optimizes continuous group scales separately from the assignment of discrete integers. Evaluating each integer candidate with its closed-form optimal scale has been used for per-channel quantization; JointQ extends it to group-wise quantization, where a row's scales are coupled through the Hessian, and applies it to refine the GPTQ solution. Each local-search move changes one integer and recomputes its group's optimal scale in closed form, accounting for the other groups through the full Hessian; all scales are periodically re-solved jointly. The search starts from a row-wise selection among scale-refitted candidates including the GPTQ solution, so unregularized JointQ never has a larger layer-wise calibration error than GPTQ. JointQ preserves the GPTQ output format and is thus a drop-in replacement. Across four models and four settings, JointQ improves six-task average zero-shot accuracy over vanilla GPTQ in 14 of 16 comparisons and perplexity in 12 of 16. The mean accuracy gain increases from 0.0044 in W4G128 to 0.1559 in W3 per-channel, and JointQ also improves average accuracy over GPTQ with MSE-based scale search and activation ordering in all eight per-channel comparisons, though rarely in G128. An ablation shows that JointQ's diagonal Tikhonov regularization mitigates severe W3 per-channel perplexity degradation, so the largest gains are not due to the local search alone. Overall, JointQ's primary empirical benefit is downstream accuracy preservation in challenging low-bit and large-group regimes. Code is available in the OneComp library at https://github.com/FujitsuResearch/OneCompression.
arxiv.titleZh: JointQ：面向大语言模型的尺度与整数联合量化
arxiv.summaryZh: GPTQ 的分组尺度与离散整数分配是分开贪心优化的，这成为低比特量化的一大瓶颈。JointQ 把逐通道量化中「每个整数候选配闭式最优尺度」的做法推广到分组量化：每次局部搜索改动一个整数，并用完整 Hessian 闭式重算该组最优尺度（同时计入其他组的影响），再周期性联合重解所有尺度；搜索起点为行内重拟合候选（含 GPTQ 解），因此无正则版本的分层校准误差不劣于 GPTQ。在 4 个模型、4 种设置下，16 组对比中 14 组六任务零样本平均准确率优于原版 GPTQ、12 组困惑度更优，平均准确率增益从 W4G128 的 0.0044 升到 W3 per-channel 的 0.1559；消融显示对角 Tikhonov 正则缓解了 W3 per-channel 的困惑度崩溃。工作保持 GPTQ 输出格式可直接替换，主要价值在于低比特、大分组场景下的下游精度保持。
arxiv.reason: 后训练量化求解器改进，属高效推理方向，扎实但增量

arxiv.title: Reading or Remembering? Measuring Temporal Contamination in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Language models are now used to read central-bank text for economic forecasting, but most were trained on text written after the documents they read. A model reading a 2021 FOMC statement may already know that inflation rose in 2022, so part of its apparent skill can be memory of the outcome, a temporal form of test-set contamination. We measure this memory on FOMC statements and minutes from 2000 to 2026 by comparing modern open models with chronologically consistent models, which are trained only on text from before a fixed date. Asked about past GDP outcomes given only a date, models that cannot know the answer still reach an AUC of up to 0.64 from priors on dates and eras, so chance is the wrong baseline. Against these memory-free models on the same questions, most modern models recall which years had strong growth. Membership-inference scores sort documents by era and document type rather than by whether a model saw them, as exact counts in an open pretraining corpus show. In real-time nowcasts, every lookahead premium we estimate on US GDP is smaller than the forecast comparison can detect at macroeconomic sample sizes, and none on GDP or inflation survives correction for multiple testing. Lookahead audits should therefore measure memory directly against memory-free models on the same items.
arxiv.titleZh: 阅读还是记忆?测量语言模型中的时间污染
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言模型常被用来阅读央行文本做经济预测，但多数模型的训练语料晚于所读文档，模型可能已知 2022 年通胀上行的结果，形成时间维度的测试集污染。研究在 2000–2026 年 FOMC 声明与会议纪要上，把现代开放模型与只见过固定日期之前文本的「时间一致」模型对比，直接测量记忆:对仅给日期的历史 GDP 问题，不可能知道答案的模型靠日期与年代先验即可达到最高 0.64 的 AUC，说明随机基线并不成立;同题目上多数现代模型能回忆哪些年份增长强劲，而成员推断分数更多按年代与文档类型而非「是否见过」排序。在真实实时 nowcast 中，所估计的美国 GDP 前瞻溢价均小于宏观样本量下预测比较可检出的幅度，GDP 与通胀上的溢价经多重检验校正后也无一显著。结论是前瞻性审计应在同一批题目上直接对照无记忆模型。
arxiv.reason: 时间污染评测方法学有价值，但落点为央行文本经济预测，属擦边

arxiv.title: Safe Resemblance, Silent Propagation: Limits of Text-Similarity Guardrails for AI Agent Safety
arxiv.abstract: When AI agents relay information to one another, an output can preserve an injected instruction's effect on downstream agents even after its wording changes, yet legitimate quotation and template reuse can produce high textual overlap with the source, so text-similarity guardrails that attempt to flag the former risk conflating these two cases. We test this distinction using DonkeyRail, a public classifier combining BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR features, deployed in a controlled three-agent email relay, defining a behavioral measure in which an output counts as functional (the injected procedure induces fresh computations in two subsequent agents) independent of the detector's score, alongside legitimate controls that explicitly authorize quotation and reuse. At its default threshold the classifier misses 8 of 19 functional outputs while flagging 70 of 192 legitimate replies, with every completed quotation and template-reuse reply triggering a false alert; calibrating for low false positives on one template set does not transfer, as the recalibrated threshold detects only one functional output and still produces 15 false alerts on new templates. We also identify an operating-point error in all 21 published classifier configurations, where ROC interpolation replaces direct threshold application, and show formally that high AUC against a surface-level text criterion provides no distribution-free guarantee of high AUC against the behavioral target, while the existing evaluation labels lack the joint observations needed to estimate the gap. An authorization analysis further shows that identical visible transcripts can require different safety decisions depending on the governing policy, a distinction no observation-only classifier can resolve. These results argue for behavioral and policy-grounded evaluation over text-similarity guardrails.
arxiv.titleZh: 「相似即安全」的假象与静默传播:文本相似度护栏在AI Agent安全中的局限
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体转发时，注入指令即使改写措辞仍能保留对下游Agent的功能影响，而合法引用与模板复用同样带来高文本重叠，基于文本相似度的护栏难以区分二者。工作以公开分类器DonkeyRail(融合BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR特征)在三Agent邮件中继中做受控实验，用与检测分数无关的行为指标(注入流程能否让后续两个Agent产生全新计算)作为真值，并设置显式授权引用与复用的合法对照组。默认阈值下19个功能性输出漏检8个，192条合法回复误报70条，且校准后的阈值无法迁移到新模板集(仅检出1个功能性输出、仍产生15次误报);同时指出21个已发布配置均存在以ROC插值替代直接阈值应用的操作点错误，并形式化证明表层文本准则上的高AUC不能保证行为目标上的高AUC。结论主张以行为与策略依据取代文本相似度作为Agent安全评测基础。
arxiv.reason: Agent安全与评测可靠性，属高分方向，但样本规模有限

arxiv.title: Differentiable Exact Learning
arxiv.abstract: We introduce a framework for differentiable exact learning that couples an unbounded external environment to a state-tracking neural controller, which we train on policy-trajectory observations (PTOs): expert behavior traces that expose observations and actions while hiding internal states. In addition to the learning framework, we introduce Differentiable Finite-State Transducers (DFSTs) which use multilinear updates, support log-parallel training, and emulate arbitrary finite-state controllers, yielding computational universality through environmental interaction. From tiny training datasets, compact DFSTs achieve extreme length generalization on arithmetic and universal-simulation tasks. We replicate the success of DFSTs on RNNs and GRUs, thereby supporting a broader learning recipe: State-Tracking Controller + Unbounded External Environment + PTOs = Extreme Length Generalization. Beyond length generalization, our metric-extraction protocol recovers interpretable discrete controllers from trained DFSTs, which we prove equivalent to the target arithmetic and universal-simulation algorithms. Furthermore, for our Softmax DFST models, simply taking $\mathrm{argmax}$ over the transition probabilities yields discrete controllers which provably exactly perform universal Turing-machine simulation and binary arithmetic. Proving exact learning for the neural controllers requires assumptions, which we empirically support. We make our code, training recipes, model weights, and proof checkers publicly available at https://github.com/fanagor/DEL.
arxiv.titleZh: 可微精确学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对神经控制器在无界外部环境中难以精确学习状态跟踪与长度泛化的问题，提出可微有限状态转换器（DFSTs）：采用多线性更新、支持对数并行训练，可模拟任意有限状态控制器，并以策略轨迹观测（PTOs）训练。小数据下紧凑 DFST 在算术与通用模拟任务上实现极端长度泛化，RNN/GRU 亦可复现该学习配方。从训练后 DFST 抽取的离散控制器可证明等价于目标算法，Softmax DFST 取 argmax 后能精确执行通用图灵机模拟与二进制算术。
arxiv.reason: 状态跟踪与长度泛化工作扎实，但非LLM主线

arxiv.title: Do Embedding-Map Distances Guide LLM Ideation? Four Tests Against What Came Next
arxiv.abstract: A popular ideation recipe treats an embedding map of existing work as a guide: pick points far from everything and decode them into ideas. I test four ways such distances could guide ideation against what appeared later. (1) Far random directions are not text: no later item reaches a raw cosine above about 0.10 with one (after centring or whitening, 22 of 24 cells stay out of reach), and an LLM decoder shown a target's neighbours, with score-only feedback, writes those neighbours in all six target sets. A neighbour-free search writes coherent text at median cosine 0.57 and 0.47 to interior gaps, beating the nearest existing item on 15 and 14 of 20, but only 0.07 and 0.06 to far points. (2) On k-means cells of a past-only map, the registered hole score mostly tracks cell size and position; three density-based gap scores forecast which cells grow fastest at or below chance (AUC 0.30 to 0.66) and add nothing to momentum in Steam and arXiv, with patents inconclusive; more isolated new Steam games are slightly better reviewed. (3) LLM continuations of arXiv papers stay closer to the source than papers that cite it, under three user prompts and against proposal rewrites (gpt-4o) and April-December 2023 papers (OLMo). Critique lengthens this step beyond content-free revision, replicated on 150 new papers. Revealing a real follow-up's title turns the ideas by 0.032 along a follow-up-specific direction beyond revision; reviewer, oracle and distance feedback add 0.13, 0.08 and 0.34 of that turn (upper bounds 0.46, 0.46, 0.70), and their turn is not separable from revision or their longer step. (4) For inspiration material graded by distance, no inverted U was detected, on an anticipation margin that tracks format more than content. Original tests were registered before running, follow-ups (thirteen requested in two AI-agent reviews) after the main results; all are dated only by local git commits.
arxiv.comment: 48 pages, 5 figures. Code, data pointers and pre-registrations: https://github.com/JaviMaligno/latent-gap-ideas
arxiv.titleZh: 嵌入图距离能引导LLM构思吗？四项针对「后来发生了什么」的检验
arxiv.summaryZh: 检验一套流行构思做法是否成立：把已有工作的嵌入图当作灵感地图，选取远离所有已有条目的点并解码成想法。四项预先注册的测试分别考察：远端随机方向并不对应任何真实文本，基于密度的空隙分数对后续增长的预测力至多与随机相当（Steam与arXiv上AUC 0.30–0.66，对动量无增量），LLM续写比引用文献更贴近原文，以及按距离筛选灵感材料时不存在倒U形关系。在真实后续标题的引导下，评审、oracle与距离反馈仅分别带来0.13、0.08、0.34的转向，说明「潜在空隙即创新机会」的直觉缺乏经验支持，对AI for Research中的构思与评估设计有直接参考价值。
arxiv.reason: 系统检验embedding空隙式构思法的可靠性，属AI for Research方法学

arxiv.title: Stream of Belief: Eliciting Collective Intelligence through Latent Belief Dynamics
arxiv.abstract: In this work, we view multi-agent reasoning as a process of seeking a collective equilibrium of implicit belief dynamics and introduce Stream of Belief (SoB), where agents maintain continuous latent beliefs and iteratively refine them through communication and reflection. Our method seeks a collective belief state of a multi-agent system where further communication induces no meaningful information propagation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the generalization of SoB across tasks and model families. More Broadly, our results suggest a new perspective on scaling multi-agent reasoning from belief dynamics.
arxiv.titleZh: 信念之流:通过潜在信念动力学激发集体智能
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体推理中，通信往往带来冗余信息而非有效增益。该工作将多智能体推理视为隐式信念动力学的集体均衡求解问题，提出Stream of Belief(SoB):每个智能体维护连续的潜在信念，并通过通信与反思迭代更新，直至继续通信不再产生有意义的信息传播，即收敛到集体信念状态。实验在多个任务与多个模型家族上验证了方法的泛化性。结果为从信念动力学视角扩展多智能体推理提供了新思路，适用于需要多智能体协作求解的推理场景。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体推理与信念动力学建模，属Agent方向扎实工作

embodied.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
embodied.abstract: Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential largely untapped. We ask whether frontier-scale representations can provide a stronger foundation for robot learning. We introduce ScaleVLA, which connects a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT, and systematically compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared training setup. We evaluate three fundamental capabilities of robot foundation models. In sample efficiency, just 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained with 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%). In generalization, LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1%, compared with at most 31.3% for smaller backbones. In precise manipulation, real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10 successes, with gains concentrated in contact-sensitive alignment. Despite its scale, ScaleVLA achieves 216 ms median latency per action chunk. Our findings suggest that frontier VLMs can serve not only as reasoning agents, but also as powerful representational foundations for efficient and generalizable robot policies.
embodied.titleZh: ScaleVLA：将视觉-语言-动作模型扩展到 5520 亿参数
embodied.summaryZh: 研究前沿规模 VLM 能否作为机器人策略的表示基础。将 552B 的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 骨干连接到可训练的动作 DiT，在统一训练设置下系统对比 2B 到 552B 的 VLM。结果显示：仅用 10 条演示即达 87.8% 成功率，超过用 50 条演示训练的 2B 骨干（85.6%）；LIBERO-PRO 泛化成功率 45.1%，小骨干至多 31.3%；真机充电器插入从 4/10 提升到 9/10，增益集中在接触敏感的对齐环节，单动作块中位延迟 216 ms。表明前沿 VLM 不仅可作推理智能体，也可作为高效、可泛化机器人策略的表示底座。
embodied.reason: 旗舰级 VLA 规模扩展技术报告，直接命中 VLA 训练方向

embodied.title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
embodied.abstract: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarness, a harness that lets frozen models use force without demonstrations or finetuning. After calibrating hand force from a wrist sensor or joint torques alone, ForceHarness addresses the first challenge with self-terminating force primitives that regulate force on their own and return at a contact event. To address the second challenge, a physics translation layer turns each force trace into physical quantities with uncertainty as the tool result. To evaluate ForceHarness against expert force controllers and learned policies under identical conditions, we also build HiddenPhys, a seven-task MuJoCo benchmark with hidden physical variables. On a real arm without a wrist force sensor, ForceHarness raises the zero-shot success rate of GPT-6 Astra from 3.3% to 90.0%. In simulation, it adds 17.5 percentage points on the public ForceBench suite and 34.3 percentage points on HiddenPhys, surpassing force-aware policies trained on demonstrations on both benchmarks and matching hand-written expert controllers on HiddenPhys. Ablations further show that smaller models make significantly better decisions when given physical quantities rather than raw force values.

embodied.titleZh: ForceHarness：把力转化为动作与物理量，交给冻结的前沿模型
embodied.summaryZh: 前沿多模态模型已能零样本从图像控制机器人，但接触力无法从图像中看到：接触力变化远快于 API 模型的决策频率，冻结模型也无法解析原始力信号。ForceHarness先由腕部力传感器或仅关节力矩标定手部受力，再用自终止力原语在模型之下闭环调节力、于接触事件返回，并以物理翻译层把力轨迹转换为带不确定性的物理量作为工具结果交还模型，全程无需示范与微调。在无腕力传感器的真机上把GPT-6 Astra的零样本成功率从3.3%提升到90.0%；仿真中ForceBench提高17.5个百分点、HiddenPhys提高34.3个百分点，超过示范训练的力觉策略，并在HiddenPhys上追平手写专家控制器。消融显示小模型拿到物理量比拿到原始力值时决策明显更好。

embodied.title: ThinkWAM: Rethinking Latent Futures for Action Refinement
embodied.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of future states. An initial action chunk may be flawed. A future prediction that is not conditioned on the chunk may fail to reflect the changes that the proposed actions would induce in visual representations, limiting its usefulness for refinement before execution. We introduce ThinkWAM, a latent WAM that establishes bidirectional feedback before execution through a proposal-rethink-refine loop: the policy first proposes a complete action chunk, the proposal corrects multi-horizon future latents through a learned residual, and the corrected latents are injected into a second pass of the same action head, which generates the executable chunk. An affordance-guided observation-action memory and a near-fine, far-coarse multi-horizon prediction scheme, both motivated by predictive coding, support this loop, and all prediction stays in latent space. ThinkWAM achieves 98.70% success on LIBERO, 84.76% on LIBERO-Plus without OOD fine-tuning, 85.75%/65.85% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Random, and 65.17% on RoboCasa24. ThinkWAM achieves 64.4% mean success across three real-world OOD conditions. The mean two-pass inference latency per action chunk is 153.48 ms on LIBERO, 164.61 ms on RoboTwin, and 101.2 ms on the Galaxea A1Z. Ablations show complementary gains from rethinking and affordance guidance. Diagnostics indicate that proposal-conditioned corrections change both predicted futures and action trajectories, showing that the corrected future representations improve the final action.

embodied.titleZh: ThinkWAM：重新思考潜在未来以精炼动作
embodied.summaryZh: 现有世界-动作模型的未来预测往往不以动作块为条件，难以反映候选动作会引发的视觉表征变化，因此无法在动作执行前提供有效的修正信号。ThinkWAM 构建「提议-再审-精炼」循环：策略先提出完整动作块，再由该提议通过学到的残差修正多个时间尺度的未来 latent，随后把这些修正后的 latent 注入同一动作头的第二遍前向，生成可执行动作块；同时用 affordance 引导的观察-动作记忆，以及接近当前位置预测更细、远处更粗的多尺度预测，支撑该循环，全程在潜空间完成。在 LIBERO 上取得 98.70% 成功率，在无 OOD 微调的情况下于 LIBERO-Plus 上取得 84.76%，在 RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Random 上分别为 85.75%/65.85%，在 RoboCasa24 上为 65.17%，在真实世界的三项 OOD 条件下平均 64.4%；每个动作块的两遍推理延迟分别为 153.48ms（LIBERO）、164.61ms（RoboTwin）和 101.2ms（Galaxea A1Z）。消融实验显示再审与 affordance 引导的增益互补，诊断实验表明以提议为条件的修正同时改变预测未来与动作轨迹，说明修正后的未来表征确实改善了最终动作。
embodied.reason: WAM 潜空间未来修正闭环，多个基准和真机验证扎实，符合 VLA 与 WAM 方向

embodied.title: Robotic Reward Models in the Foundation-Model Era
embodied.abstract: Robotic reward models (RRMs) use foundation models to replace per-task reward engineering with reusable, task-conditioned evaluation. Yet under one name, their outputs answer different questions, from whether a task succeeded to which execution is better. This survey organizes 114 methods into five semantic families by the question their native outputs answer: Outcome, Absolute Progress, Relative, Temporal Value, and Hybrid. Within this taxonomy, we review how model design determines what an evaluator can judge, how raw experience becomes supervision, and how existing evaluation practice tests the result. The review exposes a gap: agreement with demonstration order and downstream policy gains do not show whether a reward tracks task fulfillment. We therefore introduce RRM-Bench-1K, 1,117 real-robot videos of closed-loop executions with task-state and camera-evidence labels, and four contrast suites that separate the credited condition from its usual cues. A unified study of 27 evaluators shows that the strongest final scores rank whole executions well enough for selection and filtering. Dense credit, however, follows the progression of an execution more closely than its task state, and no evaluator signals when the decisive view is missing. How much fidelity a reward model needs therefore depends on the decision it drives. We outline directions from real-failure supervision to metrics that separate task state from chronology, and open-source RRM-Hub, a toolbox in which 14 existing RRMs can be readily applied and new evaluators tested on the same capabilities.
embodied.titleZh: 基础模型时代的机器人奖励模型
embodied.summaryZh: 机器人奖励模型用基础模型替代逐任务奖励工程，但同名输出实际回答的是不同问题。本综述按原生输出所回答的问题把114种方法归入五类语义家族:结果、绝对进度、相对比较、时间价值与混合，并梳理模型设计如何决定评估器能判断什么、原始经验如何变成监督信号。作者指出与演示顺序的一致性及下游策略收益并不能证明奖励跟踪了任务完成度，为此发布含1,117段真机闭环视频与任务状态、相机证据标注的RRM-Bench-1K及四组对照套件;对27个评估器的统一研究显示最强模型足以用于整体执行的选择与过滤，但密集信用更贴近执行进程而非任务状态，且无一能在决定性视角缺失时发出信号。

embodied.title: ReRead: Wrong Predictions, Useful Representations - Correcting Frozen Robot Policies by Re-reading Their Own Representations
embodied.abstract: When a pretrained robot policy fails on challenging tasks, common remedies include retraining the backbone, adding an external visual encoder, or introducing a memory module. We argue that wrong predictions do not imply wrong representations: a policy can retain the required information yet fail to read it out as the correct action. To test this view, we propose ReRead: with the backbone frozen, a corrector re-reads the current and two previous caches to predict an action residual. The corrector sees no images, is trained solely on offline demonstrations from all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, and adds only 4.17% latency. Ablations and interventions show that the correction relies on the backbone's own representations: none of four external visual encoders adds further gain, and swapping in past caches from other trajectories sharply increases action error. On the 11 hardest RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, ReRead improves the success rates of LingBot-VLA, $π_{0.5}$, and Fast-WAM by 23.45, 13.09, and 8.00 percentage points, respectively. In paired evaluation on all 50 tasks, it raises Fast-WAM's average success rate from 90.73% to 92.66%. On a Flexiv dual-arm robot, it raises success on a phase-ambiguous task from 0% to 36%.
embodied.titleZh: ReRead:错误预测，有用表征——通过重读自身表征纠正冻结的机器人策略
embodied.summaryZh: 预训练机器人策略在困难任务上失败时，通常被归咎为表征不足，于是重训 backbone、外挂视觉编码器或加记忆模块;本文主张预测错不等于表征错，所需信息可能仍在，只是没被正确读出。ReRead 冻结 backbone，用一个不接触图像的 corrector 重读当前与之前两个 cache 来预测动作残差，仅用 RoboTwin 2.0 全部 50 个任务的离线演示训练，只增加 4.17% 延迟。在 11 个最难任务上，LingBot-VLA、π0.5、Fast-WAM 的成功率分别提升 23.45、13.09、8.00 个百分点，50 任务配对评估中 Fast-WAM 平均成功率由 90.73% 升至 92.66%,Flexiv 双臂真机上阶段歧义任务由 0% 升至 36%。消融显示四种外部视觉编码器均无额外收益，替换为其他轨迹的 past cache 会显著增大动作误差。
embodied.reason: 冻结 VLA 重读自身表征做残差纠正，跨三个策略与真机验证

embodied.title: Stochastic Self-Distillation for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
embodied.abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotics through imitation learning, yet fine-tuning them with on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is limited. In group-based RL methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), every rollout step requires multi-step ODE integration, and the sampler's limited stochasticity leads to rollout groups with low variance. We propose VLA-SSD, which addresses both high inference latency and limited stochasticity. In particular, our method self-distills a pretrained flow-matching action head into a stochastic one-step policy by conditioning a single-jump generator on a Brownian path. We derive a conditional action density via our stochastic one-step policy, enabling efficient post-training via likelihood-ratio RL algorithms. We show that distilling VLA-SSD from the $π_0$ VLA reduces the action head's forward-pass time by a factor of 7.7, at the cost of a 5.5% relative decrease in the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark. However, by leveraging the increased sample diversity of VLA-SSD during group generation, post-training a $π_{0.5}$ VLA using GRPO yields a 20.6% relative improvement.
embodied.titleZh: 面向基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型的随机自蒸馏
embodied.summaryZh: 流匹配VLA的on-policy RL微调受限于多步ODE积分的高延迟与采样随机性不足，导致GRPO等组式方法生成低方差rollout组。VLA-SSD将预训练流匹配动作头自蒸馏为随机一步策略：以布朗路径为条件构造单跳生成器，并推导条件动作密度以支持似然比RL后训练。从π0-VLA蒸馏后，动作头前向时间缩短7.7倍，LIBERO成功率相对下降5.5%；利用提升的样本多样性对π0.5-VLA做GRPO后训练，成功率相对提升20.6%。为流式VLA的高效RL后训练提供了可用的随机一步策略与密度估计路径。

embodied.title: ACiT: Proprioceptive-Prior Action Chunking with Inverted Transformers
embodied.abstract: Visuomotor policies condition action prediction on visual and proprioceptive observations. While historical proprioceptive sequences carry rich dynamic priors, current methods treat them as equal to high-dimensional vision, causing the proprioceptive signal to be overwhelmed. To identify what is lost in equal-conditioning fusion, we analyze proprioceptive data and find that strong inter-joint coupling is the key action-determining structure. This finding aligns with the neural sensorimotor loop, in which proprioception first forms a body-centered prior and vision is later calibrated via parietal remapping. Inspired by this, we propose ACiT, Proprioceptive-Prior Action Chunking with Inverted Transformers, which reinforces historical joint-coupling as the primary condition with vision as a later calibration. This design is instantiated through three modules: Inverted State Encoding builds a proprioceptive prior via per-joint tokens and inter-joint self-attention. State-Visual Grounding lets joint tokens query visual evidence, making vision goal- and calibration-only. Inverted Action Chunking decodes per-joint trajectories independently. ACiT improves success rates on most LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world tasks, with the largest gains on those that require dynamics and coordination. The same conditioning design transferred to the VLA backbone pi_0-ACiT yields significant gains with better execution efficiency.
embodied.titleZh: ACiT：基于倒置 Transformer 的本体感受先验动作分块
embodied.summaryZh: 现有视运动策略把历史本体感受序列与高维视觉等同条件化，使本体信号被淹没。ACiT 分析发现关节间强耦合是决定动作的关键结构，据此把历史关节耦合作为主条件、视觉仅作后置校准：倒置状态编码用逐关节 token 与关节间自注意力构建本体先验，状态—视觉接地让关节 token 查询视觉证据，倒置动作分块独立解码各关节轨迹。在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 与真机任务上成功率普遍提升，对动态与协调要求高的任务增益最大；同一条件化设计迁移到 pi_0 VLA 主干后同样显著提分并改善执行效率。
embodied.reason: VLA 架构创新，本体先验条件化并迁移至 pi_0，命中 VLA 训练方向

embodied.title: Learning and Verifying Progress: Closed-Loop Agentic Planning with Progress-Enhanced Execution for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Navigation
embodied.abstract: Long-horizon vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to track instruction progress and recover from local errors before they propagate across subtasks. However, executors trained on expert trajectories encounter policy-induced state shifts during deployment, and their stop signals do not reliably indicate subtask completion. We introduce Learning and Verifying Progress for VLN (LeaP-VLN), an agentic VLN system that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification through plan--execute--verify--recover cycles. LeaP-VLN leverages progress both explicitly, through a progress verifier that verifies subtask completion before the agent advances and triggers dual-phase recovery upon route deviation, and implicitly, by co-training the executor on progress reasoning and action prediction to enhance the executor's progress awareness and corrective control. To adapt the executor to this closed-loop interface, we propose a two-stage progress-enhanced curriculum: behavior cloning on expert demonstrations, followed by joint training on demonstrations, expert action corrections, and progress-reasoning supervision. Policy-generated trajectories expose the executor to both intra-subtask drift and inter-subtask state shifts, aligning training with the deviations encountered during closed-loop execution. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates among monocular methods trained without additional navigation datasets, while real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness of LeaP-VLN in long-horizon navigation.
embodied.titleZh: 学习并验证进度：面向长程视觉语言导航的闭环智能体规划与进度增强执行
embodied.summaryZh: 长程视觉语言导航中的执行器在部署时会遭遇策略引发的状态偏移，其停止信号也无法可靠指示子任务是否完成。LeaP-VLN 用「规划—执行—验证—恢复」闭环把进度感知执行与独立进度验证耦合起来：进度验证器在推进前确认子任务完成，并在路线偏移时触发双阶段恢复；执行器通过进度推理与动作预测联合训练获得纠错控制能力。配套的两阶段课程先在专家示教上做行为克隆，再联合示教、专家动作纠正与进度推理监督训练，使训练与闭环执行中的子任务内漂移和子任务间状态偏移对齐。在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 上，该方法在未使用额外导航数据集训练的单目方法中取得最高成功率，真机长程导航实验也验证了其有效性。
embodied.reason: 闭环智能体式VLN，进度验证与课程训练机制清晰，含真机验证

embodied.title: MetaAct: Self-Evolving Executable Action Constraints for Embodied Language Agents
embodied.abstract: Self-evolving language agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for continuously improving agent behavior through experience. However, most existing approaches evolve textual artifacts, which can influence action preferences but cannot reliably enforce action admissibility in embodied environments with discrete and often irreversible actions. We propose MetaAct, which shifts self-evolution from textual guidance to executable action constraints by synthesizing GEAR (Grounded Executable Action Rules) from execution feedback. Each rule is represented as a typed specification, compiled into a deterministic guard, and validated offline through trajectory replay without additional model calls or environment interactions. Across four benchmarks, MetaAct improves task performance; on ScienceWorld and WebShop, violations drop from 70% to 0% and 40% to 1%, with score gains of +10.1 and +8.0. Our code is available at https://github.com/BaiCubed/MetaAct.
embodied.titleZh: MetaAct：面向具身语言智能体的自进化可执行动作约束
embodied.summaryZh: 现有自进化语言智能体的做法是演化文本经验，这类经验只能影响动作偏好，无法在动作离散且往往不可逆的具身环境中可靠保证动作可执行。MetaAct 改为从执行反馈中合成带类型规范的可执行动作规则（GEAR），再把它编译成确定性守卫（guard），并通过轨迹回放离线校验，无需额外模型调用或环境交互。在四个基准上任务表现均有提升：ScienceWorld 与 WebShop 的违规率分别从 70% 降到 0%、从 40% 降到 1%，得分提升 +10.1 与 +8.0。该工作把智能体自我进化的产物从提示文本换成可执行约束，适用于对动作合法性有硬性要求的具身智能体。
embodied.reason: 智能体自我进化转向可执行动作约束，方法清晰、指标扎实

embodied.title: Lift, See, Act: Hierarchical Robot Policy Pretraining with 3D Foundation Models
embodied.abstract: Robot policy pretraining based on human videos is crucial for improving the policy's generalization ability. One main challenge for this task is the lack of explicit action-relevant representations in such unlabeled data. Recent works tend to estimate 3D hand motion trajectories from videos using 3D foundation models (3D FMs). However, they keep solely the sparse trajectories as supervision, ignoring the rich, fine-grained information produced during the trajectory extraction process. To address this issue, we propose LSA, a hierarchical robot policy pretraining framework that includes three phases: Lift, See, and Act. Specifically, the Lift phase elevates 2D video observations into dense 3D representations by adaptively aligning features in the policy's shallow layers with the intermediate representations extracted from multiple 3D FMs. Building upon these lifted representations, the See phase equips the policy with explicit geometric and interactive awareness through dual guidance. It introduces depth-map reconstruction to help the model comprehend 3D spatial layouts and utilizes hand region cues to explicitly supervise the encoder's attention toward task-relevant interaction hotspots. Empowered by the dense 3D representation learning and precise spatial guidance, our policy achieves robust and accurate robotic manipulation in the Act phase. Extensive experiments on diverse simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that LSA significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches. The project page is available at: https://yiyuan00.github.io/Lift-See-Act.
embodied.titleZh: Lift, See, Act：基于3D基础模型的分层机器人策略预训练
embodied.summaryZh: 从无标注人类视频预训练机器人策略时，现有做法只用3D基础模型抽取的稀疏手部轨迹做监督，丢掉了提取过程中的细粒度信息。LSA把预训练拆成三个阶段:Lift阶段将策略浅层特征与多个3D基础模型的中间表示自适应对齐，把2D观测提升为稠密3D表示;See阶段通过深度图重建与手部区域线索双重引导，让编码器具备几何理解并把注意力聚焦到交互热点;Act阶段在此表示上执行操作。在多种仿真与真实任务上，LSA显著优于现有SOTA，为利用3D基础模型做稠密监督的策略预训练提供了可复用范式。
embodied.reason: 机器人策略预训练新配方，3D稠密监督机制清晰，属VLA预训练方向扎实工作
